meanings_summary.en: traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar; lunar calendar; agricultural calendar
meanings_summary.es: calendario tradicional chino; calendario agrícola; calendario lunisolar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Peasant farming (农) follows the passage of cosmic time beneath heaven (历) recorded in the lunar calendar (农历).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El cultivo campesino (农) sigue el transcurso de los ciclos del cielo (历) registrado en el calendario lunar (农历).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combining agrarian rhythm (农) with historical and astronomical passage (历), 农历 is deeply anchored to the twenty-four solar terms (二十四节气) which guided ancestral Chinese agricultural sowing, harvesting, and festive reunions for millennia.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'nóng' (35) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'lì' (51). Move cleanly from the rising melodic glide into the decisive downward drop.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 农历 specifically designates China's traditional lunisolar calendar that synchronizes lunar phases with agricultural solar terms.

contrasts.analysis: 农历 is the traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar used for agrarian cycles and ancestral festivals, whereas 公历 is the internationally standard Gregorian solar calendar used for civil administration and modern commerce.

农历 is strictly a lunisolar calendar incorporating 24 solar terms to reflect solar cycles, while 阴历 colloquially refers to lunar reckoning, though in strict astronomy 阴历 relies solely on lunar moon phases without solar adjustments.
农历 refers to the cultural calendar system itself, whereas 日历 denotes the physical calendar booklet, wall chart, or digital schedule application displaying day-to-day dates.

senses.definition_es: calendario tradicional chino lunisolar basado en ciclos astronómicos y 24 periodos solares para guiar la agricultura y las fiestas
senses.example_phrase: 农历新年 (Lunar New Year)

example_sentences.hanzi: 每逢农历除夕，全家人无论走得多远，都会赶回家吃一顿热气腾腾的年夜饭。
example_sentences.pinyin: Měi féng Nónglì Chúxī, quánjiā rén wúlùn zǒu de duō yuǎn, dōu huì gǎnhuí jiā chī yí dùn rèqì téngténg de niányèfàn.
example_sentences.en: Every Lunar New Year's Eve, no matter how far family members have traveled, they rush home to share a steaming reunion dinner.
example_sentences.es: Cada víspera del Año Nuevo lunar, por lejos que hayan viajado, los miembros de la familia se apresuran a regresar al hogar para compartir una humeante cena de fin de año.

example_sentences.hanzi: 农历不仅是一套历法体系，更深刻融入了中国古代农耕文明的物候节律与礼俗制度。
example_sentences.pinyin: Nónglì bùjǐn shì yí tào lìfǎ tǐxì, gèng shēnkè róngrù le Zhōngguó gǔdài nónggēng wénmíng de wùhòu jiélǜ yǔ lǐsú zhìdù.
example_sentences.en: The lunisolar calendar is not merely a chronological system, but is profoundly integrated into the phenological rhythms and ritual institutions of ancient Chinese agrarian civilization.
example_sentences.es: El calendario tradicional no es solo un sistema cronológico, sino que está profundamente arraigado en los ritmos fenológicos y las instituciones rituales de la civilización agraria china.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 農 (辰 celestial time + 曲 field harvest). Depicts agricultural labor attuned to heavenly seasonal cycles.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A peasant sheltered beneath a wide woven hat (冖) tending fertile shoots in the field with patient devotion.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un campesino protegido por un sombrero ancho (冖) labrando con devoción los brotes fértiles de la tierra.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 曆 (calendar) and 歷 (experience). Phono-semantic compound where 力 provides sound beneath sheltering cliff 厂.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Recording cycles of seasons beneath a rocky cliff (厂) with steady, enduring human effort (力).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Grabar los ciclos estacionales bajo un acantilado (厂) con la fuerza y empeño (力) de las manos humanas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 每当翻开传统的农历，四季更迭的节律总会唤醒深层的乡愁。春耕夏耘，秋收冬藏，我们在月圆月缺间体悟生命的丰盈。农历不仅记录着岁月，更寄托着千家万户对团聚的永恒期盼。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Měi dāng fānkāi chuántǒng de nónglì, sìjì gēngdié de jiélǜ zǒng huì huànxǐng shēncéng de xiāngchóu. Chūngēng xiàyún, qiūshōu dōngcáng, wǒmen zài yuèyuán yuèquē jiān tǐwù shēngmìng de fēngyíng. Nónglì bùjǐn jìlù zhe suìyuè, gèng jìtuō zhe qiānjiā-wànhù duì tuánjù de yǒnghéng qīpàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Whenever opening the traditional lunar calendar, the rhythms of shifting seasons awaken deep nostalgic longings. Sowing in spring and storing in winter, we perceive the richness of life between waxing and waning moons. The agricultural calendar not only marks passing years, but cradles eternal hopes of reunion.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cada vez que se abre el calendario lunar tradicional, el compás de las cuatro estaciones despierta una honda nostalgia. Entre siembras primaverales y cosechas otoñales, contemplamos la plenitud de la vida. Este calendario no solo registra el tiempo, sino el anhelo perenne de reencuentro familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 农历是中国古代天文学与农业实践高度融合的智慧结晶，精准协调了太阳与月亮的运行周期。二十四节气被列入人类非物质文化遗产名录，标志着以农历为载体的东方自然生态观获得了国际社会的广泛认同。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Nónglì shì Zhōngguó gǔdài tiānwénxué yǔ nóngyè shíjiàn gāodù rónghé de zhìhuì jiéjīng, jīngzhǔn xiétiáo le tàiyáng yǔ yuèliang de yùnxíng zhōuqī. Èrshísì jiéqì bèi lièrù rénlèi fēiwùzhì wénhuà yíchǎn mínglù, biāozhì zhe yǐ nónglì wéi zàitǐ de dōngfāng zìrán shēngtàiguān huòdé le guójì shèhuì de guǎnfàn rèntóng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The lunar calendar is the crystalline culmination of ancient Chinese astronomy and farming, harmonizing the cycles of the sun and moon. The inclusion of the 24 Solar Terms on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list marks global recognition of the ecological worldview embodied by this calendar.
extended_reading_passages.es: El calendario tradicional es la cristalización del saber astronómico y agrícola chino, armonizando los ciclos solares y lunares. La inscripción de los 24 Periodos Solares en la lista del Patrimonio Inmaterial de la UNESCO ratifica el reconocimiento mundial de su cosmovisión ecológica.

meanings_summary.en: legend; folklore; mythical story; it is said that; tradition
meanings_summary.es: leyenda; relato mítico; tradición popular; se dice que; según dicen

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What one person passes down (传) through spoken words (说) becomes an enduring legend (传说).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Lo que una persona transmite (传) mediante palabras habladas (说) se convierte en una leyenda (传说) eterna.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Oral traditions in ancient China relied on storytelling (说) transmitted across generations (传). Legends like Nian (年兽) and the white-bearded immortal explained seasonal rituals, moral codes, and protective customs.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'chuán' (35) followed by high level 1st tone 'shuō' (55). When '传' is used in 'biography' (zhuàn), it is 4th tone (51), but in 'chuánshuō' it must remain 2nd tone (35).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 传说 refers to folklore or traditional myth passed down orally across generations, or verbal hearsay ('it is said').

contrasts.analysis: 传说 (legend) is often anchored to specific historical times, folk figures, or real cultural rituals (such as the origin of New Year's Eve), whereas 神话 (myth) deals with primordial deities, cosmic genesis, and supernatural creation.
传说 focuses on narrative folklore explaining origins of customs, whereas 寓言 is an instructive fable designed explicitly to impart a moral or philosophical lesson.
传说 is culturally valued oral heritage or benign hearsay, whereas 谣言 refers to harmful, unfounded, and misleading rumors deliberately or negligently spread.

senses.definition_es: leyenda; relato tradicional transmitido oralmente a lo largo de generaciones

senses.example_phrase: 传说除夕有怪兽出没 (legend has it that a beast roamed on New Year's Eve)

example_sentences.hanzi: 传说中国古代有一种凶猛的怪兽叫“年”，每到除夕夜便会从深海爬上岸伤害人畜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō Zhōngguó gǔdài yǒu yì zhǒng xiōngměng de guàishòu jiào "Nián", měi dào Chúxī yè biàn huì cóng shēnhǎi pá shàng'àn shānghài rén chù.
example_sentences.en: Legend has it that in ancient China there was a ferocious beast called "Nian", which would crawl ashore from the deep sea every New Year's Eve to harm people and livestock.
example_sentences.es: Según cuenta la leyenda, en la antigua China existía una fiera temible llamada "Nian" que cada víspera de Año Nuevo emergía de las profundidades marinas para dañar a personas y ganado.

example_sentences.hanzi: 民间文学研究表明，许多关于除夕习俗的传说不仅承载着神话色彩，更折射出早期人类战胜自然灾害的集体心理。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mínjiān wénxué yánjiū biǎomíng, xǔduō guānyú Chúxī xísú de chuánshuō bùjǐn chéngzài zhe shénhuà sècǎi, gèng zhéshè chū zǎoqī rénlèi zhànshèng zìrán zāihài de jítǐ xīnlǐ.
example_sentences.en: Research in folklore indicates that many legends surrounding New Year's Eve customs not only possess mythical qualities, but also reflect humanity's early collective psychology in conquering natural calamities.
example_sentences.es: Los estudios de literatura folclórica revelan que las leyendas sobre las costumbres de fin de año albergan elementos míticos y reflejan la psicología colectiva ancestral para superar los desastres naturales.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras orales (讠) narradas con deleite (兑) por los ancianos alrededor del fuego para fascinar a la aldea.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在围炉夜话的冬日里，关于年兽的传说总能轻易拨动游子的心弦。口耳相传的故事不仅承载着先民对凶险的敬畏，更寄托了以智慧驱散厄运的勇气。古老传说早已化作文化基因，世代相传。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài wéilú yèhuà de dōngrì lǐ, guānyú Niánshòu de chuánshuō zǒng néng qīngyì bōdòng yóuzǐ de xīnxxián. Kǒu'ěr-xiāngchuán de gùshì bùjǐn chéngzài zhe xiānmín duì xiōngxiǎn de jìngwèi, gèng jìtuō le yǐ zhìhuì qūsàn èyùn de yǒngqì. Gǔlǎo chuánshuō zǎoyǐ huàzuò wénhuà jīyīn, shìdài xiāngchuán.
extended_reading_passages.en: During winter evenings around the hearth, legends of the beast Nian easily strike a chord in wandering hearts. Stories passed down by word of mouth carry ancestors' awe of peril and reflect the courage to disperse misfortune through wisdom. Ancient legends have long crystallized into cultural heritage passed through generations.
extended_reading_passages.es: Alrededor del fuego en noches de invierno, las leyendas de la fiera Nian conmueven a quienes están lejos del hogar. Relatos orales que transmiten el respeto de los antepasados ante el peligro y la valentía de ahuyentar el infortunio con ingenio. Estas viejas leyendas integran el patrimonio cultural transmitido entre generaciones.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 民俗学视角下的除夕传说，是农耕社会应对时间过渡危机的一套仪式化表达。通过对红布与爆竹声响的象征运用，传说将古人对凶险自然的恐惧转化为重构秩序的庆典，展现出强大的文化凝聚力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mínsúxué shìjiǎo xià de Chúxī chuánshuō, shì nónggēng shèhuì yìngduì shíjiān guòdù wēijī de yí tào yíshìhuà biǎodá. Tōngguò duì hóngbù yǔ bàozhú shēngxiǎng de xiàngzhēng yùnyòng, chuánshuō jiāng gǔrén duì xiōngxiǎn zìrán de kǒngjù zhuǎnhuà wéi chónggòu zhìxù de qìngdiǎn, zhǎnxiàn chū qiángdà de wénhuà níngjùlì.
extended_reading_passages.en: From a folkloric perspective, the New Year's Eve legend is a ritualized response of agrarian society to the crisis of temporal transition. Through the symbolic use of red cloth and firecrackers, the legend transmutes fear of nature's perils into celebrations that restore social order, demonstrating cultural cohesion.
extended_reading_passages.es: Desde la perspectiva folclórica, las leyendas de fin de año constituyen una respuesta ritualizada de la sociedad agraria a la transición temporal. Mediante el uso simbólico de telas rojas y petardos, transforman el temor a los peligros naturales en festejos que restablecen el orden, mostrando gran cohesión cultural.

meanings_summary.en: to hurt; to harm; to injure; to inflict damage; bodily injury; harm
meanings_summary.es: herir; lastimar; dañar; perjudicar; lesión; perjuicio

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A physical wound on a person (伤) paired with malicious harm under the roof (害) causes catastrophic damage (伤害).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una herida corporal en la persona (伤) unida al perjuicio bajo techo (害) causa un daño (伤害) irreparable.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese moral philosophy links 'shāng' (physical, visible cut) with 'hài' (insidious domestic or ethical malice, as in 伤天害理). In the folklore of Nian, villagers united defensive symbols (red, fire, sound) to prevent the monster from harming (伤害) vulnerable kin.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'shāng' (55) plunging directly into falling 4th tone 'hài' (51). Distinct drop in pitch reinforces decisive impact.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 伤害 emphasizes inflicting tangible bodily injury, emotional grief, or direct damage onto people or relationships.

contrasts.analysis: 伤害 applies primarily to animate beings, bodily health, or emotional feelings (伤害感情、身体伤害), whereas 损害 typically targets abstract rights, corporate interests, or material assets (损害利益、损害名誉).
伤害 describes actual damage or injury already inflicted on a specific victim, whereas 危害 denotes a pervasive, ongoing threat or danger to broader entities (e.g. 危害社会安全, 危害生态环境).

伤害 focuses on living beings or vulnerable relationships suffering harm, whereas 破坏 denotes the physical smashing, structural dismantling, or disruptive destruction of physical structures, systems, or rules.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在人际沟通中，不经意的冷淡言辞往往会对亲近之人的感情造成深深的伤害。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài rénjì gōutōng zhōng, bùjīngyì de lěngdàn yáncí wǎngwǎng huì duì qīnjìn zhī rén de gǎnqíng zàochéng shēnshēn de shānghài.
example_sentences.en: In interpersonal communication, thoughtless and cold words often inflict deep harm on the feelings of those close to us.
example_sentences.es: En la comunicación interpersonal, las palabras frías e involuntarias a menudo causan un profundo daño a los sentimientos de los seres queridos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 传说凶兽年常在除夕下山伤害百姓与家畜，村民不得不四处躲避以防遭受致命摧残。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō xiōngshòu Nián cháng zài Chúxī xiàshān shānghài bǎixìng yǔ jiāchù, cūnmín bùdébù sìchù duǒbì yǐfáng zāoshòu zhìmìng cuīcán.
example_sentences.en: Legend says the vicious beast Nian would descend from the mountains on New Year's Eve to harm villagers and livestock, forcing villagers to flee in hiding from lethal havoc.
example_sentences.es: Cuenta la leyenda que la fiera Nian bajaba de las montañas en fin de año para lastimar a los aldeanos y al ganado, obligándolos a refugiarse para evitar una fatal calamidad.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 傷. Depicts a person (亻) wounded by an arrow or blade, weeping or bleeding from trauma.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person (亻) bent over clutching a painful sword slash (㐅) across the chest, suffering a bleeding wound.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona (亻) encorvada que se sujeta el pecho cruzado por una herida de espada (㐅) sangrante y dolorosa.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound of roof (宀) sheltering harsh, piercing words (丯) uttered from the mouth (口), bringing internal destruction to the household.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Cruel, stabbing words spoken by a mouth (口) under the house roof (宀) bring disaster and lasting harm (害) to the family.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras hirientes pronunciadas por una boca (口) bajo el techo doméstico (宀) acarrean desgracia y daño (害) familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 言语的伤害往往比刀刃更为锋利，它悄无声息地穿透防线，在心灵深处留下隐秘的创伤。我们在人际交往中，不仅要保护自己免受伤害，更应常怀善意与同理心，避免刺痛身边的亲友。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yányǔ de shānghài wǎngwǎng bǐ dāorèn gèngwéi fēnglì, tā qiāowúshēngxī de chuāntòu fángxiàn, zài xīnlíng shēncù liúxià yǐnmì de chuāngshāng. Wǒmen zài rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng, bùjǐn yào bǎohù zìjǐ miǎn shòu shānghài, gèng yīng chánghuái shànyì yǔ tónglǐxīn, bìmiǎn cìtòng shēnbiān de qīnyǒu.
extended_reading_passages.en: Verbal hurt is often sharper than a blade, quietly penetrating defenses to leave hidden wounds deep within the soul. In interpersonal relationships, we must not only protect ourselves from harm, but also maintain kindness and empathy to avoid wounding loved ones.
extended_reading_passages.es: El agravio de las palabras suele ser más afilado que una espada, traspasando barreras en silencio para dejar hondas cicatrices en el alma. Al relacionarnos, debemos protegernos de sufrir daños y cultivar la empatía para no lastimar a los seres queridos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代法治体系对侵权责任的界定，始终围绕是否造成人身或财产的实质伤害展开。随着网络普及，精神创伤与名誉损害等新型非物质伤害，正促使司法机关不断完善赔偿标准与法律保护机制。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài fǎzhì tǐxì duì qīnquán zérèn de jièdìng, shǐzhōng wéirào shìfǒu zàochéng rénshēn huò cáichǎn de shízhì shānghài zhǎnkāi. Suízhe wǎngluò pǔjí, jīngshén chuāngshāng yǔ míngyù sǔnhài děng xīnxíng fēiwùzhì shānghài, zhèng cùshǐ sīfǎ jīguān bùduàn wánshàn péicháng biāozhǔn yǔ fǎlǜ bǎohù jīzhì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern legal systems, determining tort liability centers on whether tangible harm has been inflicted on persons or property. With widespread internet usage, non-material injuries such as emotional distress and defamation are prompting judiciaries to continuously refine compensation standards and legal protections.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el marco jurídico actual, la responsabilidad civil gira en torno a si se causó un daño sustancial a las personas o al patrimonio. La era digital plantea perjuicios morales e infracciones a la intimidad, exigiendo a los tribunales perfeccionar los baremos indemnizatorios.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Radiant blooming talent (英) fused with indomitable masculine strength (雄) creates an immortal hero (英雄).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El talento floreciente (英) aunado a una fuerza masculina indómita (雄) forja al héroe (英雄) inmortal.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Classical Chinese philosophy distinguishes 'yīng' (extraordinary insight and spiritual brilliance) and 'xióng' (physical audacity, military leadership, and sheer willpower). Only those possessing both qualities were hailed as true 英雄, from mythical culture heroes (Yu the Great, Houyi) to folk saviors in festivals.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'yīng' (55) followed by rising 2nd tone 'xióng' (35). The voice glides cleanly upward on 'xióng' without hesitation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 英雄 emphasizes rare moral courage, extraordinary feats, or selfless sacrifice that earns admiration from a community or civilization.

contrasts.analysis: 英雄 highlights monumental historical deeds, spiritual nobility, and lasting renown, whereas 勇士 focuses primarily on physical battlefield bravery or daring martial skill.
英雄 centers on admired heroism, gallantry, and virtue, whereas 领袖 emphasizes organizational authority, strategic political governance, and leadership over a group or nation.
英雄 is celebrated for selfless sacrifice, heroic deeds, and collective contributions, while 偶像 denotes an idol or celebrity admired for charm, talent, or popular aesthetic appeal.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在除夕夜拯救全村的老者虽然没有留下真实姓名，但在村民心中他就是驱除年兽的真正英雄。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Chúxī yè zhěngjiù quáncūn de lǎozhě suīrán méiyǒu liúxià zhēnshí xìngmíng, dàn zài cūnmín xīnzhōng tā jiùshì qūchú Niánshòu de zhēnzhèng yīngxióng.
example_sentences.en: Although the elder who saved the whole village on New Year's Eve left no real name, in the villagers' hearts he was the true hero who vanquished the beast Nian.
example_sentences.es: Aunque el anciano que salvó a la aldea en fin de año no dejó su nombre real, en el corazón de los campesinos fue el auténtico héroe que expulsó a la fiera Nian.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对突发的自然灾害与公共危机，广大一线救援人员恪尽职守，用血肉之躯谱写了当代平民英雄的壮丽篇章。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā de zìrán zāihài yǔ gōnggòng wēijī, guǎngdà yīxiàn jiùyuán rényuán kèjìnzhíshǒu, yòng xuèròuzhīqū pǔxiě le dāngdài píngmín yīngxióng de zhuànglì piānzhāng.
example_sentences.en: Confronting sudden natural disasters and public crises, frontline rescue personnel fulfilled their duties devotedly, writing a magnificent chapter of contemporary grassroots heroes with their own flesh and blood.
example_sentences.es: Ante desastres naturales repentinos y crisis públicas, los rescatistas de primera línea cumplieron su deber con entrega, forjando con su esfuerzo un capítulo heroico de héroes anónimos.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ave rapaz majestuosa (隹) que despliega alas musculosas (厷) dominando el firmamento con vigor indomable.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在民间传说中，真正的英雄并非无所不能的神仙，而是在众人畏惧时敢于挺身而出的凡人。正如除夕夜那位持烛而立的老者，以智慧与勇气点燃火光，英雄的意义在于给身处困境的人们带来希望。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài mínjiān chuánshuō zhōng, zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng bìngfēi wúsuǒbùnéng de shénxiān, érshì zài zhòngrén wèijù shí gǎnyú tǐngshēn'érchū de fánrén. Zhèngrú Chúxī yè nà wèi chízhú ér lì de lǎozhě, yǐ zhìhuì yǔ yǒngqì diǎnrán huǒguāng, yīngxióng de yìyì zàiyú gěi shēnchǔ kùnjìng de rénmen dàilái xīwàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In folk legends, true heroes are not omnipotent deities, but mortal humans who dare to step forward when others shrink in fear. Just as the elder who stood holding a candle on New Year's Eve igniting flames with wisdom and courage, the essence of a hero lies in bringing hope to people trapped in adversity.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las leyendas populares, los verdaderos héroes no son deidades omnipotentes, sino personas comunes que dan un paso al frente cuando los demás temen. Al igual que el anciano que encendió la lumbre en fin de año con serenidad y valentía, el sentido del héroe radica en infundir esperanza ante la adversidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 英雄叙事是连接传统文脉与当代价值的精神纽带。从古代抗击凶险的开拓先驱，到现代危难救援中的奉献者，英雄的内涵虽随时代变迁而演进，但其舍己为人、勇挑重担的精神内核始终历久弥新。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yīngxióng xùshì shì liánjiē chuántǒng wénmài yǔ dāngdài jiàzhí de jīngshén niǔdài. Cóng gǔdài kàngjī xiōngxiǎn de kāituò xiānqū, dào xiàndài wēinàn jiùyuán zhōng de fèngxiànzhě, yīngxióng de nèihán suī suí shídài biànqiān ér yǎnjìn, dàn qí shějǐ-wèirén, yǒngtiāo zhòngdān de jīngshén nèihé shǐzhōng jiǔmǐxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Heroic narratives serve as a spiritual bridge linking traditional heritage with contemporary values. From trailblazing pioneers fighting perils in antiquity to selfless rescuers in modern disasters, although the connotations of heroes evolve across eras, their altruism and readiness to bear heavy burdens remain ever vibrant.
extended_reading_passages.es: La narrativa heroica es el lazo espiritual que une la herencia tradicional con los valores contemporáneos. Desde los pioneros antiguos que combatieron peligros hasta los abnegados rescatistas de hoy, la noción de héroe evoluciona, pero su vocación altruista de cargar con el bienestar ajeno perdura inalterable.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: With words wrapped neatly (句) and many provisions (多) stored, everything is plentiful and enough (够).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Con palabras medidas (句) y muchas provisiones (多) acumuladas, todo es abundante y basta (够).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 够 (traditionally 夠) combines 多 (many/abundant) with 句 (enclosing container/measure). Cognitive conceptualization links sufficiency to fullness within boundaries—neither lacking nor overflowing, reflecting the Confucian ideal of moderation (中庸) and contentment (知足).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'gòu' (51). Starts at top pitch 5 and drops sharply to pitch 1. When preceding another 4th tone word (e.g. 够用), maintain the full sharp descent without softening.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 够 denotes reaching a quantitative, qualitative, or physical threshold of sufficiency or satiety.

contrasts.analysis: 够 is informal and monosyllabic, functioning flexibly as verb or adverb (够好、够吃), whereas 足够 is a formal disyllabic adjective/adverb emphasizing an ample, fully satisfactory margin of sufficiency in objective assessments.
够 denotes quantitative adequacy or meeting a baseline need, whereas 充分 emphasizes qualitative thoroughness, completeness, and exhaustive preparation (e.g. 理由充分, 准备充分).
够 describes reaching a required quantitative quota or standard, whereas 满足 focuses on internal psychological contentment or satisfying desires and specifications.

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕前夕，母亲早早备齐了够全家人吃上大半个月的年货与各色面点。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī qiánxī, mǔqīn zǎozǎo bèi qí le gòu quánjiā rén chī shàng dà bàn gè yuè de niánhuò yǔ gèsè miàndiǎn.
example_sentences.en: On the eve of New Year's Eve, mother prepared in advance enough New Year provisions and pastries to feed the whole family for over half a month.
example_sentences.es: En las vísperas de fin de año, la madre preparó con anticipación provisiones y bocadillos suficientes para alimentar a toda la familia durante más de medio mes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对突发的公共卫生事件，只有储备够充足的医疗物资与应急生活用品，城市系统才能保持高效运转。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā de gōnggòng wèishēng shìjiàn, zhǐyǒu chǔbèi gòu chōngzú de yīliào wùzī yǔ yìngjí shēnghuó yòngpǐn, chéngshì xìtǒng cái néng bǎochí gāoxiào yùnzhuǎn.
example_sentences.en: Confronting sudden public health events, only by stockpiling sufficiently adequate medical supplies and emergency necessities can municipal systems sustain efficient operation.
example_sentences.es: Ante emergencias sanitarias repentinas, solo almacenando suministros médicos y bienes de primera necesidad bastante suficientes puede el sistema urbano mantener un funcionamiento eficiente.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cuando las palabras (句) se extienden al caer la noche (夕) y completan lo necesario, las provisiones bastan (够).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕夜的温情，不在于餐桌上的山珍海味是否奢华，而在于一家人围坐在一起，能够彼此倾听与守望。只要心与心贴得够近，屋外的风雪再大，屋内的欢声笑语也足以驱散一整年的疲惫与寒意。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī yè de wēnqíng, bù zàiyú cānzhuō shàng de shānzhēn-hǎiwèi shìfǒu shēhuá, ér zàiyú yì jiā rén wéizuò zài yìqǐ, nénggòu bǐcǐ qīngtīng yǔ shǒuwàng. Zhǐyào xīn yǔ xīn tiē de gòu jìn, wūwài de fēngxuě zài dà, wūnèi de huānshēng-xiàoyǔ yě zúyǐ qūsàn yì zhěng nián de píbèi yǔ hányì.
extended_reading_passages.en: The warmth of New Year's Eve lies not in whether delicacies on the table are lavish, but in a family gathering together, able to listen to and care for one another. As long as hearts stay close enough, no matter how harsh winter winds blow outside, laughter indoors suffices to dispel the entire year's fatigue and chill.
extended_reading_passages.es: La calidez de la nochevieja no depende del lujo de los manjares, sino de reunir a la familia para escucharse y acompañarse mutuamente. Con tal de que los corazones permanezcan bastante unidos, por fuerte que sople el viento afuera, las risas interiores bastan para disipar el frío y el cansancio de todo un año.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代城市应急管理体系的韧性，取决于其在突发危机面前是否拥有够完善的物资调度网络与信息预警机制。只有基层保障能力足够扎实，公共治理体系才能在风浪中经受考验，守护千家万户的平安与稳定。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài chéngshì yìngjí guǎnlǐ tǐxì de rènxìng, qūjué yú qí zài tūfā wēijī miànqián shìfǒu yōngyǒu gòu wánshàn de wùzī diàodù wǎngluò yǔ xìnxī yùjǐng jīzhì. Zhǐyǒu jīcéng bǎozhàng nénglì zúgòu zhāshí, gōnggòng zhìlǐ tǐxì cái néng zài fēnglàng zhōng jīngshòu kǎoyàn, shǒuhù qiānjiā-wànhù de píng'ān yǔ wěndìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The resilience of modern urban emergency management systems hinges on possessing a sufficiently robust supply dispatch network and early warning mechanism during sudden crises. Only when grassroots safeguarding capabilities are adequately solid can governance systems withstand challenges and protect public safety.
extended_reading_passages.es: La resiliencia de la gestión de emergencias urbanas depende de contar con redes de distribución y sistemas de alerta bastante desarrollados frente a las crisis. Solo con bases de apoyo suficientemente sólidas puede la administración superar las pruebas y proteger la tranquilidad de la comunidad.

meanings_summary.en: to ask; to inquire; to consult; to question
meanings_summary.es: preguntar; consultar; averiguar; inquirir; indagar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Consult through respectful spoken words (询) at the front gate (问) to make a thorough inquiry (询问).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Consulta con palabras respetuosas (询) en la puerta (问) para formular una atenta indagación (询问).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Combining 'xún' (careful, institutional consultation as in 咨询) with 'wèn' (open verbal questioning), 询问 denotes an earnest, methodical search for facts or counsel rather than a casual question.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'xún' (35) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'wèn' (51). Glide smoothly upward before dropping decisively on the closing syllable.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 询问 emphasizes formal, polite, or institutional inquiry into facts, conditions, or expert opinions.

contrasts.analysis: 问 is monosyllabic and colloquial, used for everyday casual asking (问路、问好), whereas 询问 is formal and disyllabic, used in official, medical, or investigative situations.
询问 carries an objective, transparent, and respectful tone for official or business clarification, while 打听 implies informal gossiping, personal probing, or scouting out private news.
询问 is neutral and courteous seeking genuine information, whereas 质问 is an aggressive, confrontational interrogation demanding an immediate explanation or confession.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 当陌生的白发老人踏入村庄时，见众人扶老携幼惊慌逃离，便温和地上前询问究竟。村民起初畏惧不敢言，但在老人沉静坚定的目光注视下，终于道出了年兽除夕夜下山伤人的古老秘密。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dāng mòshēng de báifà lǎorén tàrù cūnzhuāng shí, jiàn zhòngrén fúlǎo-xiéyòu jīnghuāng táolí, biàn wēnhé de shàngqián xúnwèn jiūjìng. Cūnmín qǐchū wèijù bù gǎn yán, dàn zài lǎorén chénjìng jiāndìng de mùguāng zhùshì xià, zhōngyú dàochū le Niánshòu Chúxī yè xiàshān shāngrén de gǔlǎo mìmì.
extended_reading_passages.en: When the unfamiliar white-haired elder entered the village and saw crowds fleeing in panic with elders and children, he stepped forward gently to inquire about the matter. At first villagers shrank from speaking, but under his calm and resolute gaze, they ultimately revealed the ancient secret of the beast Nian descending on New Year's Eve to harm mortals.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cuando el forastero de cabellos blancos llegó a la aldea y vio a la gente huir presa del pánico, se acercó a preguntar con serenidad lo que sucedía. Aunque al principio temían hablar, la mirada firme y apacible del anciano los animó a revelar el antiguo secreto de la fiera Nian que bajaba a herir personas en fin de año.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代公共治理中，行政机关做出重大民生决策前，必须依法开展深入的民意询问与专家论证。通过规范化制度倾听基层诉求，不仅能够有效规避执行偏差，更能显著提升公共政策的科学性与公信力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài gōnggòng zhìlǐ zhōng, xíngzhèng jīguān zuòchū zhòngdà mínshēng juécè qián, bìxū yīfǎ kāizhǎn shēnrù de mínyì xúnwèn yǔ zhuānjiā lùnzhèng. Tōngguò guīfànhuà zhìdù qīngtīng jīcéng sùqiú, bùjǐn nénggòu yǒuxiào guībì zhíxíng piānchā, gèng néng xiǎnzhù tíshēng gōnggòng zhèngcè de kēxuéxìng yǔ gōngxìnlì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In contemporary public governance, before administrative organs finalize major welfare decisions, they must conduct thorough public inquiries and expert deliberations according to law. Attending to grassroots appeals through standardized procedures avoids operational missteps and enhances the scientific rigor and credibility of public policies.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gestión pública actual, los órganos administrativos deben realizar consultas ciudadanas e informes periciales antes de tomar decisiones sobre el bienestar común. Escuchar las demandas de la sociedad mediante mecanismos normados evita desviaciones y consolida la credibilidad de las políticas públicas.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What is born of pure nature (天) and retains genuine truth (真) is sweet, unaffected innocence (天真).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Lo que brota del cielo natural (天) y conserva la verdad genuina (真) es la inocencia (天真) pura.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Daoist philosophy, 'tiān' stands for uncorrupted nature and 'zhēn' represents primordial authenticity (返璞归真). Thus 天真 originally symbolized the highest spiritual attainment of uncontrived innocence before colloquially describing childlike simplicity.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'tiān' (55) followed by high level 1st tone 'zhēn' (55). Sustain an even, clear pitch contour across both syllables without dipping.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 天真 describes unadorned childlike purity of heart, or in adult contexts, an unrealistic lack of worldly sophistication.

contrasts.analysis: 天真 emphasizes childlike spontaneity, innocence, or naive optimism, whereas 单纯 denotes lack of complexity, ulterior motives, or single-faceted structure (e.g. 动机单纯、单纯的数学问题).
天真 carries an endearing praise of pure intentions (though sometimes naive), while 幼稚 is distinctly derogatory, rebuking someone for acting childish, immature, or foolish.
天真 relates to psychological disposition and uncalculated openness, whereas 朴素 refers to outward lifestyle, plain dress, or unpretentious artistic style.

example_sentences.en: Children's innocent and carefree laughter echoed amidst New Year's Eve firecrackers, dispelling the winter chill and adults' weary hearts.
example_sentences.es: Las risas inocentes y espontáneas de los niños resonaron entre los petardos de fin de año, disipando la gélida noche y el cansancio de los adultos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕的爆竹声里，孩童们穿着红袄嬉戏打闹，眼眸里映着火光，满是未被世俗沾染的天真。那种对新衣与糖果的纯粹欢欣，让在名利场中奔波一整年的大人们，也在刹那间忆起了最初的清澈。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī de bàozhú shēng lǐ, háitóngmen chuān zhe hóng'ǎo xīxì dǎnào, yǎnmóu lǐ yìng zhe huǒguāng, mǎn shì wèibèi shìsú zhānrǎn de tiānzhēn. Nà zhǒng duì xīnyī yǔ tángguǒ de chúncuì huānxīn, ràng zài mínglìchǎng zhōng bēnbō yì zhěng nián de dàrénmen, yě zài chànà jiān yìqǐ le zuìchū de qīngchè.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amidst New Year's Eve firecrackers, children in red jackets romped cheerfully, their eyes reflecting flames and filled with innocence untouched by worldly ways. That pure delight over new clothes and sweets reminded adults hustling through life of their own long-lost inner clarity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Entre los petardos de fin de año, los niños correteaban alegres con trajes rojos, con ojos llenos de una inocencia ajena a los afanes del mundo. Aquel gozo espontáneo por estrenar ropa y dulces devolvió por un instante a los adultos la pureza de sus primeros recuerdos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在复杂的国际地缘政治与宏观经济博弈中，将竞争简化为非黑即白二元对立的视角，往往脱离实际且过于天真。唯有基于务实利益与严谨研判，才能在风云变局中掌握主动。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài fùzá de guójì dìyuán zhèngzhì yǔ hóngguān jīngjì bóyì zhōng, jiāng jìngzhēng jiǎnhuà wéi fēihēi-jíbái èryuán duìlì de shìjiǎo, wǎngwǎng tuōlí shíjì qiě guòyú tiānzhēn. Wéiyǒu jīyú wùshí lìyì yǔ yánjǐn yánpàn, cái néng zài fēngyún biànjú zhōng zhǎngwò zhǔdòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In complex geopolitical and macroeconomic struggles, reducing international rivalry to black-and-white binaries is unrealistic and overly naive. Only by rooting policies in pragmatic interests and rigorous assessment can a nation seize the strategic initiative amidst turbulent global shifts.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el complejo tablero geopolítico y macroeconómico, reducir las tensiones internacionales a esquemas binarios resulta ilusorio y excesivamente ingenuo. Solo mediante el análisis pragmático de los intereses estratégicos se puede conservar la iniciativa en tiempos de incertidumbre.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Two strong men (夫 夫) coordinate with words (曰) so one can step in and replace (替) the other.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dos hombres capaces (夫 夫) se coordinan mediante palabras (曰) para sustituir (替) al compañero.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The ancient character 替 depicted alternation of duties (代也，更也). In Chinese cultural ethics, 替 embodies altruistic solidarity: stepping forward to relieve kin, protect the weak, or take hardship upon oneself for the family.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'tì' (51). Clean, crisp downward drop without lingering vocal vibration.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 替 functions as a preposition marking beneficiary/surrogate ('on behalf of') or a verb meaning active bodily/positional substitution.

contrasts.analysis: 替 denotes doing an action on someone else's behalf or instead of them (替他买票 - buy a ticket in his place), whereas 给 marks the transfer direction or recipient of an action (给他买票 - buy a ticket as a gift to him).
为 carries a formal, noble register denoting purpose or dedication (为人民服务), whereas 替 is vernacular, pragmatic, and directly substitutes for someone's immediate physical duty (替他值班).
替 is a versatile monosyllabic word used both as a preposition and verb, while 代替 is exclusively a disyllabic transitive verb expressing structural or functional replacement of objects or positions.

example_sentences.en: Seeing the foreign elder dressed in flimsy clothes, the kind granny warm-heartedly brought over a bowl of hot porridge for him and urged him to quickly take refuge in the mountains.
example_sentences.es: Al ver que el anciano forastero vestía ropas ligeras, la abuela le sirvió con cariño un tazón de gachas calientes y le rogó que huyera a las montañas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在团队核心骨干突发疾病住院期间，青年技术骨干主动承担起职责，替他完成了重大项目的验收答辩。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài tuánduì héxīn gǔgàn tūfā jíbìng zhùyuàn qījiān, qīngnián jìshù gǔgàn zhǔdòng chéngdān qǐ zhízé, tì tā wánchéng le zhòngdà xiàngmù de yànshōu dābiàn.

example_sentences.es: Mientras el líder del equipo estuvo hospitalizado por una enfermedad imprevista, los jóvenes técnicos asumieron la tarea y lo suplieron en la defensa del proyecto.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕风雪漫天，村中青年早已逃往深山，唯有一位白发老者泰然自若地留下来。他不仅替收留自己的阿婆看守家宅，更以红绸与烛火直面猛兽，用非凡的胆魄替全村百姓换来了岁岁平安。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī fēngxuě màntiān, cūnzhōng qīngnián zǎoyǐ táowǎng shēnshān, wéiyǒu yí wèi báifà lǎozhě tàirán-zìruò de liúxiàlái. Tā bùjǐn tì shōuliú zìjǐ de āpó kānshǒu jiāzhái, gèng yǐ hóngchóu yǔ zhúhuǒ zhímiàn měngshòu, yòng fēifán de dǎnpò tì quáncūn bǎixìng huànlái le suìsuì píng'ān.
extended_reading_passages.en: On New Year's Eve amid swirling snow, village youths had fled to the mountains, leaving only a white-haired elder who remained unperturbed. He not only guarded the house for the granny who sheltered him, but also confronted the beast with red silk and candlelight, securing peace for the villagers.
extended_reading_passages.es: En una nochevieja de ventisca, los jóvenes habían huido al monte, quedando solo un anciano sereno. No solo custodió el hogar de la abuela que lo acogió, sino que encaró a la fiera con telas rojas y velas, conquistando con temple la paz de la aldea.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着新一代人工智能与自动化装备的普及，工业机器人正在危险作业环境中替人类承担繁重劳动。这种产业更替不仅有效降低了职业伤亡概率，更促使传统制造业向智能化与高附加值阶段迈进。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe xīnyídài réngōng zhìnéng yǔ zìdònghuà zhuāngbèi de pǔjí, gōngyè jīqìrén zhèngzài wēixiǎn zuòyè huánjìng zhōng tì rénlèi chéngdān fánzhòng láodòng. Zhè zhǒng chǎnyè gēngtì bùjǐn yǒuxiào jiàngdī le zhíyè shāngwáng gàilǜ, gèng cùshǐ chuántǒng zhìzàoyè xiàng zhìnénghuà yǔ gāofùjiāzhí jiēduàn màijìn.
extended_reading_passages.en: With the proliferation of next-generation artificial intelligence and automation, industrial robots are undertaking heavy labor in hazardous environments on behalf of humans. This industrial substitution reduces workplace casualty risks and propels manufacturing toward high-value intelligence.
extended_reading_passages.es: Gracias al avance de la robótica y la inteligencia artificial, los autómatas asumen labores peligrosas en lugar de los obreros. Esta sustitución técnica reduce drásticamente los accidentes laborales e impulsa la industria tradicional hacia procesos inteligentes de alto valor añadido.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Regulate with a cutting tool (制) while building step by step (造) to manufacture (制造) grand creations.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cortar con precisión reglada (制) mientras se avanza construyendo (造) para fabricar (制造) bienes duraderos.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Ancient Chinese craftsmanship distinguished 'zhì' (imposing standard geometric discipline or law) from 'zào' (physical assembly from raw materials into being). In modern usage, 制造 bridges heavy industrial production with figurative social engineering (e.g. 制造恐慌).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'zhì' (51) followed by falling 4th tone 'zào' (51). When two 4th tones are juxtaposed, articulate each with a sharp downward drop, softening slightly the first tone's bottom pitch to transition smoothly into the second.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 制造 emphasizes industrial fabrication of physical goods using machinery, or deliberately contriving an abstract situation/conflict.

contrasts.analysis: 制造 refers to the standardized physical assembly or production of items from existing designs, whereas 创造 highlights pioneering originality, invention, or artistic inspiration from scratch.
制造 usually refers to large-scale industrial factory manufacturing of machinery or hardware, whereas 制作 focuses on handicraft, film/video production, or culinary craft on an artisanal scale.

生产 is a macro-economic concept describing the whole social labor process of generating goods or agricultural harvests, whereas 制造 is the mechanical engineering and physical processing aspect of that process.

example_sentences.en: To drive off the beast Nian, the villagers followed the elder's instructions to burn bamboo in front of their doors, producing deafening crackling bangs.
example_sentences.es: Para ahuyentar a la fiera Nian, los lugareños siguieron los consejos del anciano quemando cañas de bambú ante sus puertas, produciendo ensordecedores estallidos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 凭借高端装备制造领域的重大技术突破，该省的高新技术企业在全球供应链竞争中赢得了核心话语权。
example_sentences.pinyin: Píngjiè gāoduān zhuāngbèi zhìzào lǐngyù de zhòngdà jìshù tūpò, gāi shěng de gāoxīnjìshù qǐyè zài quánqiú gōngyìngliàn jìngzhēng zhōng yíngdé le héxīn huàyǔquán.

example_sentences.es: Gracias a decisivos avances técnicos en la fabricación de maquinaria de alta gama, las empresas provinciales conquistaron una posición rectora en las cadenas mundiales de valor.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕的古老智慧，体现在先民如何借由巧思制造生机。面对身躯庞大的年兽，人们并未硬拼，而是点燃爆竹制造震耳巨响，悬挂红缎制造火光，将猛兽的弱点化为守护家园的盾牌。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī de gǔlǎo zhìhuì, tǐxiàn zài xiānmín rúhé jièyóu qiǎosī zhìzào shēngjī. Miànduì shēnqū pángdà de Niánshòu, rénmen bìngwèi yìngpīn, érshì diǎnrán bàozhú zhìzào zhèn'ěr jùxiǎng, xuánguà hóngduàn zhìzào huǒguāng, jiāng měngshòu de ruòdiǎn huàwéi shǒuhù jiāyuán de dùnpái.
extended_reading_passages.en: The ancient wisdom of New Year's Eve shines in how ancestors cleverly manufactured vitality. Confronting the gigantic beast Nian, rather than reckless combat, people burned bamboo to produce booming sounds and hung red fabrics to create glowing lights, turning the beast's weaknesses into a protective shield.
extended_reading_passages.es: La sabiduría de la nochevieja se manifiesta en cómo los ancestros supieron generar soluciones ingeniosas. Ante la fiera Nian, en vez de luchar a ciegas, quemaron bambú para producir ruidos atronadores y colgaron telas rojas, convirtiendo el pavor del monstruo en escudo del hogar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代制造业正经历从要素驱动向创新驱动的历史性跨越。随着数字化车间与工业互联网的深度融合，高端智能制造不仅大幅提升了全要素生产率，更为全球绿色低碳转型与工业升级提供了强有力的技术支撑。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài zhìzàoyè zhèng jīnglì cóng yàosù qūdòng xiàng chuàngxīn qūdòng de lìshǐxìng kuàyuè. Suízhe shùzìhuà chējiān yǔ gōngyè hùliánwǎng de shēndù rónghé, gāoduān zhìnéng zhìzào bùjǐn dàfú tíshēng le quányàosù shēngchǎnlǜ, gèng wèi quánqiú lǜsè dītàn zhuǎnxíng yǔ gōngyè shēngjí tígōng le qiángyǒulì de jìshù zhīchēng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern manufacturing is undergoing a historic leap from factor-driven to innovation-driven growth. With deep integration between digital workshops and the industrial internet, intelligent manufacturing enhances total factor productivity and provides technical support for global green industrial upgrades.
extended_reading_passages.es: La industria manufacturera moderna protagoniza un salto histórico hacia la innovación. Con la integración de fábricas digitales e internet industrial, la manufactura avanzada optimiza la productividad global y ofrece un sólido respaldo técnico para una transición industrial ecológica.

meanings_summary.en: disaster; calamity; catastrophe; devastation
meanings_summary.es: desastre; calamidad; catástrofe; siniestro

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A destructive fire under the roof (灾) that brings severe harm to the household (害) constitutes a devastating disaster (灾害).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un fuego devorador bajo el tejado (灾) que inflige grave perjuicio al hogar (害) desata un temible desastre (灾害).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Ancient agricultural civilization in China constantly battled nature's unpredictability (flood, drought, locusts, and harsh winter freezes). Mythological creatures like Nian were personified embodiments of environmental calamities (灾害). Rituals of red banners, noise, and sleepless watch (守岁) unified the community against seasonal catastrophes.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'zāi' (55) plunging directly into falling 4th tone 'hài' (51). Clear contrast from sustained high pitch to abrupt descent.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 灾害 specifically denotes wide-scale physical, meteorological, or social catastrophes causing broad devastation to populations or environments.

contrasts.analysis: 灾害 highlights the objective physical destruction and material devastation caused by events (e.g. 地质灾害, 农业灾害), whereas 灾难 emphasizes the tragic human suffering, emotional grief, and personal misery experienced by victims.

灾害 encompasses broad natural or large-scale calamities (floods, blizzards, plagues), whereas 事故 denotes localized, often man-made operational failures, mishaps, or accidents in transport and industry (e.g. 交通事故, 生产事故).

灾害 is a concrete event or phenomenon of devastation (a noun), whereas 危害 is an ongoing harmful action or detrimental potential that undermines health, safety, or society (often functioning as a transitive verb).

senses.definition_es: desastre; calamidad; catástrofe natural o humana que provoca grandes estragos y pérdidas

example_sentences.hanzi: 古代民间将年兽视为象征严冬与饥荒的凶残灾害，唯有全村老幼齐心协力方能化险为夷。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gǔdài mínjiān jiāng Niánshòu shìwéi xiàngzhēng yándōng yǔ jīhuāng de xiōngcán zāihài, wéiyǒu quáncūn lǎoyòu qíxīn-xiélì fāng néng huàxiǎn-wéiyí.
example_sentences.en: Ancient folk regarded the beast Nian as a vicious disaster symbolizing harsh winter and famine, which could only be overcome if all villagers united as one.
example_sentences.es: En el folclore antiguo se consideraba a la fiera Nian una calamidad feroz que personificaba el crudo invierno y el hambre, superable solo con la unión comunitaria.

example_sentences.hanzi: 健全的防灾减灾救灾体制能够在气象灾害来临前迅速启动预警，从而最大程度减少人员伤亡和财产损失。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiànquán de fángzāi jiǎnzāi jiùzāi tǐzhì nénggòu zài qìxiàng zāihài láilín qián xùnsù qǐdòng yùjǐng, cóng'ér zuìdà chéngdù jiǎnshǎo rényuán shāngwáng hé cáichǎn sǔnshī.
example_sentences.en: A well-developed disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief mechanism can promptly trigger early warnings before meteorological disasters strike, thereby minimizing casualties and property loss.
example_sentences.es: Un sistema integral de prevención y socorro permite activar alertas inmediatas ante desastres meteorológicos, reduciendo al máximo víctimas humanas y pérdidas materiales.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound of fire (火) blazing uncontrollably beneath a domestic roof (宀), graphically portraying an internal house fire disaster.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fire flames (火) erupting through the roof of a house (宀), illustrating a destructive household calamity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Llamas devoradoras (火) que brotan del techo de una casa (宀), simbolizando un desastre destructivo.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound where harmful words (丯) uttered from the mouth (口) beneath the roof (宀) inflict internal destruction.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Bitter words from a mouth (口) under the house roof (宀) causing discord and grave harm.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras enconadas de una boca (口) bajo el techo hogareño (宀) que desatan discordia y perjuicio familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在远古先民的记忆中，严冬与匮乏本身就是莫大的灾害。年兽下山的传说，本质上是对自然破坏力的恐惧投射。除夕夜的灯火与锣鼓，是人类在灾害面前用团结筑起的心灵防线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài yuǎngǔ xiānmín de jìyì zhōng, yándōng yǔ kuìfá běnshēn jiùshì mòdà de zāihài. Niánshòu xiàshān de chuánshuō, běnzhì shàng shì duì zìrán pòhuàilì de kǒngjù tóushè. Chúxī yè de dēnghuǒ yǔ luógǔ, shì rénlèi zài zāihài miànqián yòng tuánjié zhùqǐ de xīnlíng fángxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the collective memories of ancient ancestors, harsh winter and scarcity were immense disasters in themselves. The legend of the beast Nian descending was fundamentally a projection of fear toward nature's destructive power. The lanterns and gongs on New Year's Eve represented a spiritual defense line built through solidarity against disasters.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la memoria de los antepasados, el crudo invierno y la carestía eran grandes calamidades. La leyenda de la fiera Nian reflejaba el terror ante las fuerzas ciegas de la naturaleza. Las luces y tambores de fin de año levantaron una barrera espiritual forjada en la unión humana frente al desastre.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对日益频发的极端气候与地质灾害，构建智慧韧性城市已成为可持续发展的战略重心。通过遥感监测与大数据预警，现代应急体系能够在灾害初起时精准研判，全面守护人民生命财产安全。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì rìyì pínfā de jíduān qìhòu yǔ dìzhì zāihài, gòujiàn zhìhuì rènxìng chéngshì yǐ chéngwéi kěchíxù fāzhǎn de zhànlüè zhòngxīn. Tōngguò yáogǎn jiāncè yǔ dàshùjù yùjǐng, xiàndài yìngjí tǐxì nénggòu zài zāihài chūqǐ shí jīngzhǔn yánpàn, quánmiàn shǒuhù rénmín shēngmìng cáichǎn ānquán.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the face of increasingly frequent extreme climate and geological disasters, constructing smart, resilient cities has become a strategic priority for sustainable development. Through remote sensing and big data warnings, modern emergency systems can analyze threats precisely at the onset of disasters, comprehensively safeguarding citizens' lives and assets.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante desastres meteorológicos y geológicos cada vez más frecuentes, crear urbes inteligentes y resilientes es una prioridad estratégica. Con sensores remotos y modelos de datos, los sistemas modernos de emergencia predicen catástrofes con precisión, salvaguardando vidas y bienes.

meanings_summary.en: shadow; reflection; trace; glimpse
meanings_summary.es: sombra; reflejo; rastro; silueta

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When bright sunbeams create a silhouette (影), a tiny suffix (子) turns it into the tangible shadow (影子) cast beside you.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando los rayos del sol dibujan una silueta (影), el sufijo nominal (子) forma la sombra (影子) perceptible que te acompaña.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese philosophy and literature, 影 (shadow) symbolizes the ephemeral nature of worldly appearances and the constant companion of solitary existence (as in Li Bai's famous poem 对影成三人, 'facing my shadow makes three of us'). The nominal suffix 子 softens the monosyllable into the common spoken noun 影子.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Low dipping 3rd tone 'yǐng' (214) followed by neutral tone 'zi' (2). The first syllable exhibits full dipping contour when isolated, but in fluent speech before the neutral tone, it maintains a low dip (21) while 'zi' is pronounced lightly and briefly at a low pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 影子 designates the actual physical dark area or optical reflection cast by an object blocking light, or figuratively a faint trace or looming threat.

contrasts.analysis: 影子 denotes the optical silhouette cast by an obstruction of light or an inanimate object's shadow, whereas 身影 specifically refers to the visible posture, silhouette, or figure of a human body in motion or standing.

影子 refers to any cast shadow or optical profile on ground or walls, whereas 倒影 specifically designates an inverted optical reflection mirrored upside-down on a body of water or reflective polished surface.

影子 figuratively denotes the lingering aura, ghost, or faint trace of an issue (e.g. 摆脱过去的影子), whereas 迹象 refers to objective empirical signs, clues, or indicators pointing to a future trend or past event (e.g. 经济复苏的迹象).

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕夜的月光洒在庭院里，地上映照出积雪和老树交错的影子，孩子们在院中欢快地嬉戏。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī yè de yuèguāng sǎ zài tíngyuàn lǐ, dìshang yìngzhào chū jīxuě hé lǎoshù jiāocuò de yǐngzi, háizimen zài yuàn zhōng huānkuài de xīxì.
example_sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, moonlight spilled over the courtyard, casting intertwined shadows of old trees and snow on the ground as children played happily.
example_sentences.es: En la nochevieja, la luz de la luna bañaba el patio, proyectando sombras entrelazadas de nieve y viejos árboles mientras los niños jugaban alegremente.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在这份宏观经济调查报告中，我们不仅要分析表面的统计数据，更要看清潜藏在数字背后的结构性危机影子。

example_sentences.en: In this macroeconomic investigation report, we must not only analyze superficial statistical figures, but also clearly discern the looming shadow of structural crisis lurking behind the numbers.
example_sentences.es: En este informe de investigación macroeconómica, no solo debemos analizar los datos estadísticos superficiales, sino también distinguir con claridad la sombra de la crisis estructural que se oculta tras las cifras.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A tiny child (子) with outstretched arms, serving as a light suffix attached to concrete nouns to denote everyday tangible objects.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un pequeño niño (子) con los brazos abiertos, que sirve como sufijo ligero para otorgar carácter tangible a sustantivos cotidianos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 月光下的长街寂静无声，路灯将行人的影子拉得很长。我们总在夜色里追寻前方的微光，却常常忽略了身后默默跟随的影子。它如同一面无言的镜子，映照着生命旅途中的孤独与坚定。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yuèguāng xià de chángjiē jìjìng wúshēng, lùdēng jiāng xíngrén de yǐngzi lā de hěn cháng. Wǒmen zǒng zài yèsè lǐ zhuīxún qiánfāng de wēiguāng, què chángcháng hūlüè le shēnhòu mòmò gēnsuí de yǐngzi. Tā rútóng yí miàn wúyán de jìngzi, yìngzhào zhe shēngmìng lǚtú zhōng de gūdú yǔ jiāndìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Under the moonlight, the long street is tranquil and silent, while street lamps stretch the shadows of pedestrians very long. We always seek the faint light ahead in the night, yet often overlook the shadow silently following behind us. Like a mute mirror, it reflects the loneliness and steadfast resolve throughout life's journey.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo la luna, la larga calle está en silencio sepulcral, mientras las farolas estiran las sombras de los transeúntes. Solemos perseguir la tenue luz del camino en la noche, descuidando a menudo la sombra que nos sigue en silencio. Como un espejo mudo, refleja la soledad y la firmeza a lo largo del viaje de la vida.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代城市规划与高层建筑设计中，建筑影子对公共空间的遮挡已成为环境评估的关键指标。合理的楼间距不仅能消除深沉影子的压迫感，还能确保冬季充足的自然采光，让绿色低碳理念融入日常。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài chéngshì guīhuà yǔ gāocéng jiànzhù shèjì zhōng, jiànzhù yǐngzi duì gōnggòng kōngjiān de zhēdǎng yǐ chéngwéi huánjìng pínggū de guānjiàn zhǐbiāo. Hélǐ de lóujiānjù bùjǐn néng xiāochú shēnchén yǐngzi de yāpògǎn, hái néng quèbǎo dōngjì chōngzú de zìrán cǎiguāng, ràng lǜsè dītàn lǐniàn róngrù rìcháng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern urban planning and high-rise architecture design, the obstruction of public spaces by building shadows has become a crucial environmental assessment index. Reasonable building spacing not only eliminates oppressive deep shadows, but also guarantees ample natural sunlight in winter, integrating green low-carbon concepts into daily life.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el urbanismo moderno y el diseño de rascacielos, la obstrucción del espacio público por la sombra de los edificios es un índice clave de evaluación ambiental. Una distancia adecuada entre edificios mitiga la opresión de sombras densas y asegura iluminación natural en invierno, integrando el concepto ecológico en lo cotidiano.

meanings_summary.en: besides; in addition; furthermore; moreover
meanings_summary.es: además; aparte de esto; asimismo; por otra parte

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Standing right at this point (此) and looking beyond the outer boundary (外), you discover what lies in addition (此外).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Situado en este punto (此) y mirando más allá del límite exterior (外), descubres lo que se añade además (此外).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Formed from the classical demonstrative pronoun 此 ('this') and the locative 外 ('outside/beyond'). In formal discourse, 此外 operates as a transition conjunctive marking additive rhetorical progression, bridging existing arguments with supplemental supporting points.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Low dipping 3rd tone 'cǐ' (214) followed by falling 4th tone 'wài' (51). When 3rd tone precedes 4th tone, 'cǐ' changes to half-third tone (21), dropping low without rising, before launching straight into the sharp falling 4th tone (51).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 此外 is a formal additive conjunction that introduces supplemental information or another category beyond what has already been covered.

contrasts.analysis: 此外 is more formal and primarily functions as an additive sentence-initial conjunction (in addition / furthermore), whereas 另外 is used in both speech and writing and can function as a determiner modifying nouns directly (e.g. 另外三个人).

此外 introduces a separate, parallel category or supplementary detail outside the current scope, whereas 而且 indicates step-by-step rhetorical escalation and closer cohesion within the same premise (not only... but also).
此外 neutrally appends extra facts, whereas 况且 introduces a supplementary rhetorical justification or clinching reason that further validates an argument or decision.

example_sentences.en: In preparation for the New Year's Eve banquet, maternal grandfather bought a large carp symbolizing surplus year after year; furthermore, he specifically steamed a basket of sweet, hot rice cakes.
example_sentences.es: Para preparar el banquete de nochevieja, el abuelo materno compró una gran carpa que simboliza la abundancia continua; además, preparó al vapor una cesta de pastel de arroz dulce y caliente.

example_sentences.hanzi: 本季度新产品在线上渠道销量增长显著；此外，公司海外供应链的优化也大幅降低了跨国物流运营成本。
example_sentences.pinyin: Běn jǐdù xīn chǎnpǐn zài xiànshàng qúdào xiàoliàng zēngzhǎng xiǎnzhù; cǐwài, gōngsī hǎiwài gōngyìngliàn de yōuhuà yě dàfú jiàngdī le kuàguó wùliú yùnyíng chéngběn.
example_sentences.en: In this quarter, sales of the new product across online channels grew significantly; moreover, optimizing the company's overseas supply chain substantially cut multinational logistics operating costs.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram combining 止 (foot stepping to a halt) and 匕 (a person standing nearby). Marks the exact place or matter right before oneself: 'this'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Halting one's feet (止) right beside a person (匕) to point firmly at this exact place and matter (此).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Detener los pies (止) al lado de una persona (匕) para señalar con firmeza este preciso lugar o asunto (此).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Combines 夕 (evening) and 卜 (divination). Divination took place by day; conducting divination at nightfall (夕) was outside the normal ritual boundary, giving the sense of beyond or exterior.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Gazing at the crescent moon at dusk (夕) while casting divination sticks (卜) outside the city walls.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Contemplar la luna creciente al atardecer (夕) mientras se consulta el oráculo (卜) fuera de las murallas de la ciudad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕的风俗不仅承载着驱邪祈福的心愿，更凝聚着中国人对团圆的执着追寻。全家人围坐一起包饺子、守岁迎新；此外，门前张贴的春联与窗花，也将新春的祥和与温暖渲染得淋漓尽致。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī de fēngsú bùjǐn chéngzài zhe qūxié-qífú de xīnyuàn, gèng níngjù zhe Zhōngguórén duì tuányuán de zhízhuó zhuīxún. Quánjiā rén wéizuò yìqǐ bāo jiǎozi, shǒusuì yíngxīn; cǐwài, ménqián zhāngtiē de chūnlián yǔ chuānghuā, yě jiāng xīnchūn de xiánghé yǔ wēnnuǎn xuànrǎn de línlí-jìnzhì.
extended_reading_passages.en: The customs of New Year's Eve not only carry wishes to dispel evil and pray for blessings, but also embody the Chinese people's devoted pursuit of reunion. The entire family sits together making dumplings and seeing the old year out; furthermore, Spring Festival couplets and paper-cuts pasted on doors render the peace and warmth of spring most vividly.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las costumbres de nochevieja no solo encarnan el deseo de alejar males y pedir bendiciones, sino también el profundo anhelo de unión familiar. Todos se sientan a preparar ravioles y recibir el nuevo año; además, las coplas y recortes de papel en las puertas realzan con vivacidad la armonía primaveral.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代企业管理体系中，精细化的成本管控与敏锐的市场洞察是保持竞争力的支柱；此外，构建健康开放的团队文化与持续的技术创新能力，更是决定企业能否在激烈的全球化浪潮中行稳致远的根本动力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài qǐyè guǎnlǐ tǐxì zhōng, jīngxìhuà de chéngběn guǎnkòng yǔ mǐnruì de shìchǎng dòngchá shì bǎochí jìngzhēnglì de zhīzhù; cǐwài, gòujiàn jiànkāng kāifàng de tuánduì wénhuà yǔ chíxù de jìshù chuàngxīn nénglì, gèng shì juédìng qǐyè néngfǒu zài jīliè de quánqiúhuà làngcháo zhōng xíngwěn-zhìyuǎn de gēnběn dònglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern enterprise management systems, meticulous cost control and keen market insight are the pillars of competitiveness; furthermore, building a healthy, open team culture and sustainable technical innovation capability are the fundamental forces determining whether an enterprise can achieve steady long-term growth amidst fierce globalization.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gestión empresarial moderna, el riguroso control de costes y la agudeza ante el mercado sustentan la competitividad; además, cultivar una cultura de equipo abierta y una constante innovación técnica son las fuerzas decisivas para que la empresa prospere con firmeza en la marea de la globalización.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The mouth (口) with intersecting teeth (交) clamps down to bite (咬) into something delicious or grit teeth through adversity.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La boca (口) cuyos dientes se cruzan (交) aprieta con firmeza para morder (咬) un sabroso bocado o aguantar con tesón.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese legends, fierce mythical beasts like the Nian monster (年兽) would emerge on the eve of the new year to devour and bite (咬) livestock and humans. Furthermore, in Chinese idioms like 咬紧牙关, the physical act of biting teeth together symbolizes unwavering spiritual resilience in the face of suffering.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'yǎo' (214). When followed by another 3rd tone (such as in 咬紧 yǎojǐn), 'yǎo' undergoes 3rd-tone sandhi and changes into a rising 2nd tone [yáo]. When preceding 1st, 2nd, or 4th tones, it drops to a half-third tone (21).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 咬 denotes clamping upper and lower jaws and teeth down on something to pierce, grasp, or tear it.

contrasts.analysis: 咬 refers to a single decisive bite or clamping down with teeth, whereas 啃 implies repeatedly gnawing, nibbling, or scraping away at hard food like bones or corn.
咬 is the initial penetration or clamping action using incisors and canines, whereas 嚼 is the ongoing grinding and mastication of food using molars inside the mouth.
咬 applies broadly to humans, animals, and insects biting, whereas 叮 specifically denotes the stinging or piercing bite of small flying insects (like mosquitoes) with a proboscis.

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕夜刚出锅的肉馅饺子热气腾腾，小孙子迫不及待地咬了一大口，鲜美的汤汁顿时溢满了口腔。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī yè gāng chūguō de ròuxiàn jiǎozi rèqì téngténg, xiǎo sūnzi pòbùjídài de yǎo le yí dà kǒu, xiānměi de tāngzhī dànshí yìmǎn le kǒuqiāng.
example_sentences.en: The freshly cooked meat dumplings on New Year's Eve were piping hot; the little grandson eagerly took a big bite, and delicious juice immediately filled his mouth.
example_sentences.es: En la nochevieja, los ravioles de carne recién salidos de la olla humeaban; el pequeño nieto no pudo esperar para dar un gran mordisco, y el delicioso caldo inundó su boca al instante.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对核心技术研发的瓶颈期，科研团队咬紧牙关攻坚克难，历时三年终于突破了国外长期的专利垄断。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì héxīn jìshù yánfā de píngjǐngqī, kēyán tuánduì yǎojǐn yáguān gōngjiān-kènán, lìshí sān nián zhōngyú tūpò le guówài chángqī de zhuānlì lǒngduàn.
example_sentences.en: Facing a bottleneck in core technology R&D, the scientific team clenched their teeth and overcame difficulties, finally breaking through long-standing foreign patent monopolies after three years.
example_sentences.es: Ante el cuello de botella en la investigación de tecnología clave, el equipo científico apretó los dientes para superar las adversidades y, tras tres años de esfuerzo, rompió el prolongado monopolio de patentes extranjeras.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 童年除夕最难忘的滋味，莫过于刚出锅的热饺子。轻轻咬开薄软的面皮，鲜美的汤汁瞬间在舌尖绽放。那一口温热不仅填满了饥肠，更将年节的喜庆与家人的关爱深深咬进了记忆深处。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tóngnián Chúxī zuì nánwàng de zīwèi, mòguò yú gāng chūguō de rè jiǎozi. Qīngqīng yǎokāi báoruǎn de miànpí, xiānměi de tāngzhī shùnjiān zài shéjiān zhànfàng. Nà yì kǒu wēnrè bùjǐn tiánmǎn le jīcháng, gèng jiāng niánjié de xǐqìng yǔ jiārén de guān'ài shēnshēn yǎojìn le jìyì shēncù.
extended_reading_passages.en: The most unforgettable flavor of childhood New Year's Eve was dumplings straight out of the boiling pot. Gently biting open the thin, soft wrapper, savory juices instantly bloomed upon the tongue. That warm bite not only satisfied hungry bellies, but also etched the festive joy and familial warmth deeply into memory.
extended_reading_passages.es: El sabor más inolvidable de la nochevieja en la infancia eran los ravioles recién hervidos. Al morder suavemente la fina masa, el sabroso caldo estallaba en el paladar. Aquel bocado cálido no solo saciaba el apetito, sino que grababa profundamente el júbilo festivo y el afecto familiar en el recuerdo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在极限耐力运动中，真正的考验往往不是体能的耗尽，而是精神意志的博弈。当刺骨寒风吹透衣衫、伤痛侵袭四肢时，运动员唯有咬紧牙关顶住极限压力，一步步踏向终点，方能完成对自我的终极蜕变。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài jíxiàn nàilì yùndòng zhōng, zhēnzhèng de kǎoyàn wǎngwǎng bú shì tǐnéng de hàojìn, ér shì jīngshén yìzhì de bóyì. Dāng cìgǔ hánfēng chuītòu yīshān, shāngtòng qīnxí sìzhī shí, yùndòngyuán wéiyǒu yǎojǐn yáguān dǐngzhù jíxiàn yālì, yíbù-bù tàxiàng zhōngdiǎn, fāng néng wánchéng duì zìwǒ de zhōngjí tuìbiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In extreme endurance sports, the true test is rarely mere physical exhaustion, but rather a contest of mental willpower. When biting winds pierce clothing and pain assails limbs, athletes can only grit their teeth against extreme pressure, stepping toward the finish line to complete their ultimate transformation.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los deportes de resistencia extrema, la verdadera prueba no reside en el mero agotamiento físico, sino en la contienda de la voluntad. Cuando el viento gélido cala la ropa y el dolor azota las extremidades, el atleta solo puede apretar los dientes y resistir, avanzando paso a paso hacia su superación.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Crossing blade strokes (乂) plunge into a wooden stake (木) to decisively slay and kill (杀) the threatening beast.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Filos cortantes cruzados en aspa (乂) se clavan sobre una estaca de madera (木) para matar (杀) y abatir a la bestia.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient mythology, the end of the year was associated with driving away or slaying (杀/驱) ferocious monsters like Nian (年兽) that threatened village survival. In classical thought, 杀 embodies both the stern, harvesting autumn energy (秋气主杀) and the legal sovereign power over life and death.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'shā' (55). Maintain a sustained, steady pitch at the top of the vocal register without dipping before subsequent syllables.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 杀 is the primary general verb meaning to deliberately terminate life or violently eliminate organisms or threats.

contrasts.analysis: 杀 is the broad, generic term for taking any life (human, beast, germ), whereas 宰 specifically denotes the methodical butchering and slaughtering of domestic livestock and poultry for food or sacrifice.
杀 denotes the definitive act of causing physical death, whereas 害 means to harm, injure, impair, or bring misfortune without necessarily resulting in death (as in 伤害).

杀 focuses on the physical termination of individual living beings or entities, whereas 灭 emphasizes total annihilation, wiping out of an entire category, lineage, or extinguishing fires and lights (e.g. 消灭、灭亡).

example_sentences.en: According to folk traditions, on the morning of New Year's Eve, every household slaughters chickens and fish to prepare lavish offerings to venerate ancestors and pray for peace in the coming year.
example_sentences.es: Conforme a la tradición popular, en la mañana de nochevieja cada hogar sacrifica pollos y limpia pescado para preparar abundantes ofrendas dedicadas a los antepasados y pedir paz para el año venidero.

example_sentences.hanzi: 生物医药实验室在新型抗生素研发中，成功筛选出一种能高效杀灭多重耐药性病菌的活性化合物。

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 民间传说中，远古怪兽年常在岁末残害生灵。乡民们燃起爆竹、点亮红烛，合力击退并诛杀恶兽，迎来了新春的黎明。除夕除害的传统，寄托了先民战胜严酷自然、渴望和平安宁的朴素信念。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mínjiān chuánshuō zhōng, yuǎngǔ guàishòu Nián cháng zài suìmò cánhài shēnglíng. Xiāngmínmen ránqǐ bàozhú, diǎnliàng hóngzhú, hélì jītuì bìng zhūshā èshòu, yínglái le xīnchūn de límíng. Chúxī chúhài de chuántǒng, jìtuō le xiānmín zhànshèng yánkù zìrán, kěwàng hépíng-ānníng de pùsù xìnniàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In folk legends, the ancient monster Nian frequently harmed living beings at year's end. Villagers lit firecrackers and red candles, joining forces to repel and slay the evil beast, ushering in the dawn of the new year. The tradition of eliminating perils on New Year's Eve reflects ancient people's simple faith in overcoming harsh nature and longing for peace.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las leyendas populares, la fiera Nian solía dañar a las gentes a finales de año. Los aldeanos encendían petardos y velas rojas, uniendo fuerzas para repeler y matar a la bestia, dando la bienvenida al amanecer del nuevo año. La tradición de eliminar males en nochevieja refleja la fe ancestral en vencer la hostil naturaleza y hallar paz.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代农业病虫害综合防治体系中，过度依赖广谱化学农药虽能迅速杀灭有害昆虫，但也容易破坏农田生态链。推广生物防治与靶向杀菌技术，既能有效控制病害传播，又能守护土壤生态与食品安全底线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài nóngyè bìngchónghài zōnghé fángzhì tǐxì zhōng, guòdù yīlài guǎngpǔ huàxué nóngyào suī néng xùnsù shāmiè yǒuhài kūnchóng, yě róngyì pòhuài nóngtián shēngtàiliàn. Tuīguǎng shēngwù fángzhì yǔ bǎxiàng shājūn jìshù, jìnìng yǒuxiào kòngzhì bìnghài chuánbō, yòu néng shǒuhù tǔrǎng shēngtài yǔ shípǐn ānquán dǐxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern integrated agricultural pest management systems, excessive reliance on broad-spectrum chemical pesticides can quickly kill harmful insects, but easily damages farmland ecological chains. Promoting biological control and targeted sterilization technology effectively curtails disease transmission while safeguarding soil ecology and food safety baselines.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el manejo fitosanitario agrícola moderno, el abuso de pesticidas químicos de amplio espectro extermina rápidamente insectos dañinos, pero altera la cadena ecológica. Fomentar el control biológico y la esterilización dirigida frena eficazmente la propagación de plagas y protege el suelo y la seguridad alimentaria.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Stepping up the palace terrace (阝) leaves behind all surplus troubles (余) to eliminate (除) the past and welcome a clean new year.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Al subir las escalinatas (阝), uno deja atrás las cargas sobrantes (余) para eliminar (除) lo viejo y recibir el nuevo año.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In the festival name 除夕 (New Year's Eve), 除 signifies 'clearing away the old year' (除旧布新). Ancient Chinese cultural cognition views time cyclically: only by thoroughly cleaning the home, paying debts, and driving out the monster Nian can space be cleared for positive cosmic fortune in the spring.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'chú' (35). The pitch starts in the middle range (3) and glides smoothly up to the top (5). When paired with 4th tone (除旧 chújiù) or 1st tone (除夕 chúxī), maintain a resonant rising melody.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 除 focuses on eliminating or clearing away undesirable elements, leaving aside exceptions, or the passing of cyclical time.

contrasts.analysis: 除 is a transitive verb meaning to eradicate, clear away, or remove an obstacle or disease (often combined as 消除、除去), whereas 去 is a general motion verb (to go) or directional particle (away), requiring compounding (如 去除、去掉) to specifically denote elimination.

除 in arithmetic denotes division (partitioning into equal parts) and in general usage means eradicating or setting aside, whereas 减 specifically denotes arithmetic subtraction or decreasing quantity and intensity.

除 implies active sweeping away, clearing, or exterminating impurities or obstacles (e.g. 除草、除害), whereas 免 refers to granting exemption, waiving obligations, or averting an impending negative outcome (e.g. 免费、免除处分).

example_sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, the entire family thoroughly cleans the house to discard the old and welcome the new, embodying wishes to sweep away bad luck and usher in fresh hope.
example_sentences.es: El día de nochevieja, toda la familia limpia la casa a fondo para despedir lo viejo y recibir lo nuevo, expresando el deseo de barrer la mala fortuna y dar la bienvenida a renovadas esperanzas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 企业重组方案除了精简行政冗员之外，更着力于破除内部部门壁垒，全面提升跨部门协同与决策效率。

example_sentences.en: In addition to trimming redundant administrative staff, the corporate restructuring plan focused on breaking down internal departmental silos and comprehensively elevating cross-departmental synergy and decision efficiency.
