character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mujer (女) que custodia la memoria familiar antigua (古) cuidando de la juventud de la casa.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 孃/娘. Phono-semantic compound where female radical 女 combines with 艮 (steadfast). Evolved from mother to addressing young women.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A steadfast woman (女) standing upright (艮) with dignity and gentle grace.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mujer (女) íntegra y firme (艮) que destaca por su porte sereno y gracia natural.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕的清晨，雪花染白了小村的屋檐。邻家那位手巧的姑娘早早系上围裙，在窗棂上贴满栩栩如生的窗花。她眉眼弯弯，脸上漾着纯真的欢喜，为宁静的寒冬小院平添了几分春意盎然的生机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī de qīngchén, xuěhuā rǎnbái le xiǎocūn de wūyán. Línjiā nà wèi shǒuqiǎo de gūniang zǎozǎo jìshàng wéiqún, zài chuānglíng shàng tiēmǎn xǔxǔ-rúshēng de chuānghuā. Tā méiyǎn-wānwān, liǎnshàng yàng zhe chúnzhēn de huānxǐ, wèi níngjìng de hándōng xiǎoyuàn píngtiān le jǐfèn chūnyì-àngrán de shēngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: On New Year's Eve morning, snow whitened village eaves. The skillful girl next door tied on her apron early, pasting lifelike paper-cuts onto lattice windows. With smiling eyes and innocent joy on her face, she breathed vibrant spring vitality into the quiet winter courtyard.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la mañana de nochevieja, la nieve tiñó los aleros de la aldea. La hacendosa muchacha vecina se puso el delantal temprano para pegar recortes de papel en las celosías, llenando el gélido patio invernal con la alegre frescura de la primavera.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当代乡村振兴与数字经济浪潮中，越来越多的年轻姑娘选择返乡创业。她们依托电商直播推广家乡非遗手艺与特色农产，以开阔的眼界和坚韧的实干精神，在广袤田野间绽放出属于新时代的巾帼光彩。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngdài xiāngcūn zhènxīng yǔ shùzì jīngjì làngcháo zhōng, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng gūniang xuǎnzé fǎnxiāng chuàngyè. Tāmen yītuō diànshāng zhībō tuīguǎng jiāxiāng fēiyí shǒuyì yǔ tèsè nóngchǎn, yǐ kāikuò de yǎnjiè hé jiānrèn de shígàn jīngshén, zài guǎngmào tiányě jiān zhànfàng chū shǔyú xīndàidài de jīnguó guāngcǎi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amidst rural revitalization and digital economic waves, more and more young women choose to return to their hometowns to launch enterprises. Leveraging e-commerce live-streaming to promote intangible cultural heritage and local produce, they showcase the brilliance of modern women across vast countryside fields.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el marco de la revitalización rural y la economía digital, cada vez más jóvenes deciden emprender en sus pueblos natales. Mediante transmisiones en línea, divulgan la artesanía y productos agrícolas locales, aportando la energía y entereza de la mujer contemporánea al desarrollo del campo.

meanings_summary.en: pot; pan; wok; boiler; bowl (of a pipe)
meanings_summary.es: olla; cazuela; sartén; wok; caldera

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A metal vessel (钅) curved with rounded edges (呙) forms an indispensable cooking pot (锅).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un recipiente metálico (钅) forjado con forma redondeada (呙) crea la indispensable olla (锅).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese domestic culture, the cooking pot (锅, or ancient 釜/鼎) is the primary symbol of household sustenance and culinary continuity. Phrases like 'jiē bu kāi guō' (揭不开锅, unable to open the pot) signify dire poverty, whereas a steaming hot pot on New Year's Eve represents familial plenitude and warmth.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'guō' (55). Pronounce with an even, sustained high pitch without terminal dip.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 锅 designates a metal vessel designed for cooking food or boiling water with heat applied directly underneath.

contrasts.analysis: 锅 is made of metal specifically designed for cooking over a flame, whereas 盆 is a broader basin or tub used for washing, containing liquids, or holding potted plants.
锅 is a cooking vessel used for culinary preparation over the stove, whereas 碗 is a tableware bowl held in the hand for eating rice or soup.
锅 is the cooking container that holds the food, whereas 炉 is the stove or furnace providing the heating fire beneath the pot.

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕夜的厨房里热气腾腾，铁锅中炖煮着香气扑鼻的鸡汤，一家人围坐在一起等待开饭。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī yè de chúfáng lǐ rèqì téngténg, tiěguō zhōng dùnzhǔ zhe xiāngqì pūbí de jītāng, yì jiā rén wéizuò zài yìqǐ děngdài kāifàn.
example_sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, the kitchen was steaming with warmth, and an iron pot simmered fragrant chicken soup as the whole family gathered to await the feast.
example_sentences.es: En nochevieja, la cocina desprendía un vapor acogedor; en la olla de hierro hervía una fragante sopa de pollo mientras la familia aguardaba la cena.

example_sentences.hanzi: 工业锅炉节能改造与清洁燃烧技术的推广，有效降低了工业生产中的废气排放与能源消耗。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gōngyè guōlú jiénéng gǎizào yǔ qīngjié ránshāo jìshù de tuīguǎng, yǒuxiào jiàngdī le gōngyè shēngchǎn zhōng de fèiqì páifàng yǔ néngyuán xiāohào.
example_sentences.en: The energy-saving upgrading of industrial boilers and the promotion of clean combustion technologies have effectively reduced exhaust emissions and energy consumption in industrial production.
example_sentences.es: La modernización energética de las calderas industriales y la combustión limpia han reducido notablemente las emisiones contaminantes y el gasto energético fabril.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 鍋. Phono-semantic compound where metal radical 钅 denotes metallic cookware, and 呙 provides phonetic pronunciation.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An iron metal vessel (钅) forged with rounded rims (呙) to boil feast broths over blazing firewood.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un recipiente metálico (钅) forjado con bordes curvados (呙) para cocer ricos caldos sobre la leña.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 除夕夜最诱人的年味，莫过于揭开铁锅那一瞬间升腾而起的白汽。大锅里翻滚着红烧肉与热气腾腾的饺子，浓郁的肉香弥漫了整间屋子，将外面的寒风风雪尽数隔绝在暖融融的烟火人间之外。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chúxī yè zuì yòurén de niánwèi, mòguò yú jiēkāi tiěguō nà yì shùnjiān shēngténg ér qǐ de báiqì. Dàguō lǐ fāngǔn zhe hóngshāoròu yǔ rèqì-téngténg de jiǎozi, nóngyù de ròuxiāng mímàn le zhěng jiān wūzi, jiāng wàimiàn de hánfēng-fēngxuě jìnshù géjué zài nuǎnróngróng de yānhuǒ rénjiān zhīwài.
extended_reading_passages.en: The most enticing flavor of New Year's Eve is nothing other than the white steam billowing up the instant the iron pot lid is lifted. In the large pot tumbled braised pork and piping hot dumplings, rich meat fragrances filling the room and shutting cold winter winds completely outside domestic warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: El aroma más cautivador de la nochevieja surge al destapar la olla de hierro entre densas nubes de vapor. En el caldero borbotean cerdo guisado y empanadillas calientes cuyo perfume inunda el hogar, aislando la gélida ventisca fuera del entrañable calor familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 从粗放式的大锅饭分配机制，到以质量效益为导向的现代企业激励体制，中国经济管理理念在改革开放中完成了深刻跃迁。破除平均主义的坚冰，极大地激发了全社会的创新创造潜能与微观市场活力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Cóng cūfàngshì de dàguōfàn fēnpèi jīzhì, dào yǐ zhìliàng xiàoyì wéi dǎoxiàng de xiàndài qǐyè jīlì tǐzhì, Zhōngguó jīngjì guǎnlǐ lǐniàn zài gǎigé-kāifàng zhōng wánchéng le shēnkè yuèqiān. Pòchú píngjūn-zhǔyì de jiānbīng, jídà de jīfā le quán shèhuì de chuàngxīn chuàngzào qiánnéng yǔ wēiguān shìchǎng huólì.
extended_reading_passages.en: From crude common-pot allocation mechanisms to modern enterprise incentive structures oriented toward quality and efficiency, Chinese economic management philosophies underwent profound leaps during reform and opening-up. Breaking the ice of egalitarianism unleashed creative potential and market dynamism.
extended_reading_passages.es: De los esquemas igualitaristas de "olla común" a los incentivos modernos orientados a la productividad y la calidad, la gestión económica china experimentó una profunda metamorfosis. Romper la inercia del reparto uniforme dinamizó el mercado e impulsó la innovación social.

meanings_summary.en: basin; tub; pot; bowl; classifier for pots / basins of things
meanings_summary.es: palangana; lebrillo; maceta; barreño; jofaina; clasificador para tiestos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Pour water to divide it into a shallow earthenware dish (皿) to fill a clean household washbasin (盆).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Vierte agua para repartirla (分) en un cuenco ancho (皿) formando una limpia palangana (盆).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient ritual folk culture, bronze basins ('pén') were banged during lunar festivals and eclipses to make loud metal noise (鸣金), dispersing noxious demons and pestilence.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'pén' (35). Smooth upward glide from pitch 35; keep vowel resonant.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 盆 denotes a relatively large, deep, wide-mouthed circular container used for washing, gardening pots, or holding liquids.

contrasts.analysis: 盆 is an expansive, deep tub or basin for washing or planting, whereas 碗 is a small dining bowl held in the hand to eat rice or soup.
盆 has high curved walls for holding water or soil, whereas 盘 is a flat plate or shallow tray for serving food.
盆 is wide and shallow with an open top, while 桶 is a deep cylindrical bucket with vertical walls and a carrying handle.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 合 (combine) over 皿 instead of 分 in 盆
Has 舟 (boat) over 皿 instead of 分
Has 八 and 一 over 皿 instead of 分
Has 明 (bright) over 皿 instead of 分

senses.definition_en: an open, shallow, circular container or vessel; basin; tub; flowerpot
senses.definition_es: vasija ancha, redonda y abierta; palangana; barreño; maceta
senses.example_phrase: 铜盆 (bronze basin)

senses.definition_en: classifier for things contained in basins, pots, or planters
senses.definition_es: clasificador para el contenido de macetas, tiestos o palanganas
senses.example_phrase: 一盆鲜花 (a pot of fresh flowers)

example_sentences.hanzi: 传说除夕夜百姓们手持铜盆与铁锅用力敲打，清脆响亮的撞击声把年兽吓得落荒而逃。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō Chúxī yè bǎixìngmen shǒuchí tóngpén yǔ tiěguō yònglì qiāodǎ, qīngcuì xiǎngliàng de zhuàngjī shēng bǎ Nián shòu xià de luòhuāng'értáo.
example_sentences.en: Legend tells that on New Year's Eve, villagers struck bronze basins and iron pots, their clatter scaring Nian away.
example_sentences.es: Cuenta la leyenda que en Nochevieja los campesinos golpeaban palanganas de bronce y sartenes, ahuyentando a la bestia con el fragor.

example_sentences.hanzi: 春节前夕，家家户户都在门前摆上几盆金桔与水仙花，寓意新的一年吉祥如意、大吉大利。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chūnjié qiánxī, jiājiāhùhù dōu zài ménqián bǎishàng jǐ pén jīnjú yǔ shuǐxiānhuā, yùyì xīn de yì nián jíxiángrúyì, dàjídàlì.
example_sentences.en: On the eve of the Spring Festival, families display pots of kumquats and narcissus by doors, symbolizing good fortune.
example_sentences.es: En vísperas del Año Nuevo Chino, los hogares colocan macetas de mandarinos enanos y narcisos ante el portal como augurio de prosperidad.

idioms.meaning_en: torrential rain pouring like upturned basins; torrential downpour
treasure bowl; place of boundless wealth and opportunity
wash hands in a basin and stop; quit a bad practice for good
cascade down like a basin upturned; torrential rain

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where dish radical 皿 indicates a shallow container, and 分 denotes distributing water or portions.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A shallow earthenware dish (皿) used to divide and hold water (分) forms a household washbasin (盆).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una vasija ancha (皿) empleada para repartir agua (分) sirve como barreño o palangana (盆).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 腊月深冬的集市上，最引人注目的莫过于那一盆盆绽放的水仙与缀满金果的金桔树。摊主热情地向过往行人招呼推荐，买一盆鲜花摆在厅堂，既添了盎然春意，又寄托着阖家幸福、富贵吉祥的质朴祈愿。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Làyuè shēndōng de jíshì shàng, zuì yǐnrénzhùmù de mòguòyú nà yì pénpén zhànfàng de shuǐxiān yǔ zhuìmǎn jīnguǒ de jīnjúshù. Tānzhǔ rèqíng de xiàng guòwǎng xíngrén zhāohu tuījiàn, mǎi yì pén xiānhuā bǎi zài tīngtáng, jì tiān le àngrán chūnyì, yòu jìtuō zhe héjiā xìngfú, fùguì jíxiáng de zhìpǔ qíyuàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: At late-winter fairs, blooming narcissus and fruited kumquats in pots catch all eyes. Vendors greet passersby; buying a flowerpot for the parlor brings spring warmth and conveys wishes for familial joy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el mercado invernal, destacan macetas de narcisos en flor y mandarinos colmados de frutos dorados. Los puesteros ofrecen tiestos para el salón que avivan la primavera y auguran dicha familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代都市立体绿化与阳台微农业推广项目中，新型轻质陶粒与透气环保花盆的应用显著提升了植物成活率。科研机构开发出具备自动吸水与养分缓释功能的智能花盆，使都市居民在有限空间内轻松享受园艺乐趣。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài dūshì lìtǐ lǜhuà yǔ yángtái wēinóngyè tuīguǎng xiàngmù zhōng, xīnxíng qīngzhì táolì yǔ tòuqì huánbǎo huāpén de yìngyòng xiǎnzhù tíshēng le zhíwù chénghuólǜ. Kēyán jīgòu kāifā chū jùbèi zìdòng xīshuǐ yǔ yǎngfèn huǎnshì gōngnéng de zhìnéng huāpén, shǐ dūshì jūmín zài yǒuxiàn kōngjiān nèi qīngsōng xiǎngshòu yuányì lèqù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In urban vertical greening and balcony agriculture, lightweight aggregates and breathable pots boost plant survival. Researchers design self-watering smart planters, enabling city dwellers to enjoy horticulture in limited spaces.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la jardinería urbana de balcones, las macetas ecológicas transpirables elevan el arraigo vegetal. Investigadores diseñaron tiestos inteligentes autorregables con liberación de nutrientes, facilitando el cultivo en espacios reducidos.

meanings_summary.en: arrow; projectile; shaft
meanings_summary.es: flecha; saeta; dardo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A straight bamboo shaft (竹) flying forward (前) with lethal speed is a sharp flying arrow (箭).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una caña de bambú (竹) que vuela hacia adelante (前) con certera velocidad es una veloz flecha (箭).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese lore, arrows signify righteous force piercing falsehood, and the swift irreversibility of time ('guāngyīn sì jiàn' - time flies like an arrow).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Sharp falling 4th tone 'jiàn' (51). Crisp, decisive downward release imitating the flight of an arrow.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 箭 refers specifically to a notched, fletched arrow projectile shot from a bow, or components modeled on arrow flight.

contrasts.analysis: 箭 is the flying arrow projectile, whereas 弓 is the bent wooden tension bow used to launch it.
箭 is an archery projectile, while 枪 refers to spears in martial arts or modern firearms and rifles.
箭 is a slender aerodynamic bamboo/metal shaft with fletchings, whereas 弹 is a round bullet, pellet, or explosive shell.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the bamboo radical 竹 on top
Has fire radical 灬 below 前 instead of bamboo 竹 on top
Has knife radical 刀 below 前 instead of bamboo 竹
Has 由 under 竹 instead of 前

senses.definition_en: a pointed projectile shot from a bow; arrow
senses.definition_es: proyectil puntiagudo que se dispara con arco; flecha; saeta
senses.example_phrase: 射箭 (shoot arrows / archery)

example_sentences.hanzi: 传说中英勇的猎户手持强弓，将一支支燃烧着烈火的神箭射向年兽，彻底粉碎了怪兽的侵袭。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhōng yīngyǒng de lièhù shǒuchí qiánggōng, jiāng yì zhīzhī ránshāo zhe lièhuǒ de shénjiàn shè xiàng Nián shòu, chèdǐ fěnsuì le guàishòu de qīnxí.
example_sentences.en: In legend, valiant hunters held strong bows, shooting flaming arrows at the Nian beast to shatter its invasion.
example_sentences.es: Según la leyenda, los valientes cazadores empuñaron recios arcos, disparando saetas flamígeras contra la bestia Nian para repeler su ataque.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该校射箭俱乐部在全国大学生传统弓锦标赛中表现优异，队员们凭借精准的射术和稳定的心理素质屡创佳绩。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi xiào shèjiàn jùlèbù zài quánguó dàxuéshēng chuántǒng gōng jǐnbiāosài zhōng biǎoxiàn yōuyì, duìyuánmen píngjiè jīngzhǔn de shèshù yǔ wěndìng de xīnlǐ sùzhì lǚ chuàng jiājì.
example_sentences.en: The archery club performed outstandingly in traditional archery championships, clinching awards through precision and poise.
example_sentences.es: El club de tiro con arco brilló en el torneo universitario nacional de arco tradicional, cosechando triunfos gracias a su puntería y templanza.

collocations.en: arrow on the bowstring; ready for action
shoot two hawks with one arrow; achieve two goals at once
stride swiftly like an arrow in flight

idioms.meaning_en: time flies like an arrow; swift passage of time
the arrow is notched on the string; state of no turning back
kill two birds with one stone; shoot two vultures with one arrow
heart eager to return like a flying arrow; homesick urgency

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where bamboo radical 竹 indicates straight bamboo shafts used to craft arrows flying forward 前.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A slender bamboo shaft (竹) notched on a bow shoots straight forward (前) into the sky as a flying arrow (箭).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una recta caña de bambú (竹) disparada con fuerza vuela hacia adelante (前) como veloz saeta (箭).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 岁末腊月，古老村落里响起了喧天的爆竹。人们常用“光阴似箭”来感叹岁月的匆匆流逝。那一去不复返的四季风华，正如离弦之箭般决绝而迅疾，催促着每一个游子背起行囊，踏上归心似箭的团圆旅途。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suìmò làyuè, gǔlǎo cūnluò lǐ xiǎngqǐ le xuāntiān de bàozhú. Rénmen cháng yòng "guāngyīnsìjiàn" lái gǎntàn suìyuè de cōngcōng liúshì. Nà yí qù bù fùfǎn de sìjì fēnghuá, zhèng rú líxiánzhījiàn bān juéjué ér xùnjí, cuīcù zhe měi yí gè yóuzǐ bēiqǐ xíngnáng, tàshàng guīxīnsìjiàn de tuányuán lǚtú.
extended_reading_passages.en: In late winter, firecrackers sound in ancient villages. People sigh that "time flies like an arrow." Fleeting seasons rush past like arrows from bowstrings, urging every traveler to pack and hasten home for reunion.
extended_reading_passages.es: En invierno, los petardos resuenan en las aldeas. La gente suspira al ver que el tiempo vuela como una flecha. El paso veloz de las estaciones apremia a los viajeros a emprender el anhelado regreso al hogar familiar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代航空航天运载火箭研制中，箭体结构轻量化与气动布局优化是决定入轨有效载荷能力的核心指标。工程师采用高强度碳纤维复合材料打造新一代火箭箭体，大幅减轻结构自重并提升了发射可靠性。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài hángkōng hángtiān yùnzài huǒjiàn yánzhì zhōng, jiàntǐ jiégòu qīngliànghuà yǔ qìdòng bùjú yōuhuà shì juédìng rùguǐ yǒuxiào zàihè nénglì de héxīn zhǐbiāo. Gōngchéngshī cǎiyòng gāoqiángdù tànxiānwéi fùhé cáiliào dǎzào xīn yídài huǒjiàn jiàntǐ, dàfú jiǎnqīng jiégòu zìzhòng bìng tíshēng le fāshè kěkàoxìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In aerospace launch vehicle engineering, rocket hull structural lightweighting and aerodynamic design are pivotal to payload capacity. Engineers craft fuselages from carbon composites, reducing weight and enhancing launch reliability.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los cohetes espaciales de carga, aligerar el fuselaje y optimizar la aerodinámica son claves para la carga útil. Los ingenieros aplican compuestos de fibra de carbono, reduciendo el peso y reforzando la fiabilidad del despegue.

meanings_summary.en: to express; to voice; to convey; to communicate
meanings_summary.es: expresar; manifestar; transmitir; exteriorizar; comunicar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Bring inner feelings to the exterior surface (表) and convey them across the path (达) to express your true heart.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Lleva tus sentimientos al exterior (表) y transmítelos por el sendero (达) para expresar tu corazón.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese poetics, 'biǎo' brings hidden sentiment to light, while 'dá' ensures successful cognitive reception (辞达而已矣 - words need only convey the meaning).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'biǎo' (214) followed by rising 2nd tone 'dá' (35). Smooth upward transition out of the dip.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 表达 specifically denotes the deliberate externalization of inner emotions, views, or intentions through language, symbols, or gestures.

contrasts.analysis: 表达 focuses on verbal or artistic phrasing of complex thoughts, feelings, or themes (表达心意), while 表示 often means to indicate, signal, or symbolize (点头表示同意).
表达 is linguistic or intentional communication of thoughts, whereas 表现 refers to behavior, performance, or natural symptoms displayed externally.
表达 originates from the self externalizing feelings, whereas 传达 means relaying or transmitting messages/directives from an external third party.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 月 below instead of 衣 contours in 表
Has 口 inside the middle instead of 表's horizontal cross strokes
Has 力 inside 辶 instead of 大 in 达
Has 寸 inside 辶 instead of 大 in 达

senses.definition_en: to convey ideas, feelings, gratitude, or intentions through spoken language, written signs, or symbolic rituals
senses.definition_es: manifestar pensamientos, afectos o gratitud mediante palabras, gestos o ritos
senses.example_phrase: 表达美好的祝愿 (express wonderful wishes)

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕夜给长辈拜年时，晚辈们恭敬地行礼并送上吉祥话，以此表达对长辈养育之恩的诚挚感激。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī yè gěi zhǎngbèi bàinián shí, wǎnbèimen gōngjìng de xínglǐ bìng sòngshàng jíxiáng huà, yǐ cǐ biǎodá duì zhǎngbèi yǎngyù zhī ēn de chéngzhì gǎnjī.
example_sentences.en: When greeting elders on New Year's Eve, younger generations bow respectfully and offer auspicious words to express sincere gratitude for parental care.
example_sentences.es: Al felicitar a los mayores en Nochevieja, los jóvenes se inclinan con respeto y dedican frases propicias expresando su sincera gratitud.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在多边外交谈判中，代表团通过严谨精准的声明文本，清晰表达了捍卫国家主权与核心利益的坚定立场。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài duōbiān wàijiāo tánpàn zhōng, dàibiǎotuán tōngguò yánjǐn jīngzhǔn de shēngmíng wénběn, qīngxī biǎodá le hànwèi guójiā zhǔquán yǔ héxīn lìyì de jiāndìng lìchǎng.
example_sentences.en: In multilateral negotiations, the delegation articulated its firm stance on defending sovereignty and core interests through precise statements.
example_sentences.es: En las negociaciones multilaterales, la delegación expresó con firmeza su postura de defensa de la soberanía nacional mediante declaraciones precisas.

idioms.meaning_en: speak insincerely; words do not come from the heart
meaning lies beyond words; implied subtlety
overflow beyond words; show plainly on one's face
speak out freely and unreservedly

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram depicting fur garments worn with the wool facing outward on the exterior, signifying manifestation.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Wearing an elegant fur coat with the lining facing outward shows what lies on the exterior to express (表) oneself.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Llevar un abrigo con el forro hacia afuera muestra al exterior la belleza para manifestar y expresar (表) la estima.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where walking radical 辶 indicates reaching a destination or conveying thoughts across a path.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Walking along the open road (辶) with confident, big strides (大) allows your ideas to reach and convey (达) effectively.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Caminar por el sendero (辶) a grandes pasos (大) permite que tus palabras lleguen y transmitan (达) el mensaje.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 春联上的每一个金色大字，都是中华儿女对生活最深情的表达。那一副副红纸黑字的楹联，写满了对岁序更迭的由衷赞美与对家庭安康的殷切期盼。千百年来，人们正是通过这些古老形式，将血脉相连的温情代代传递。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūnlián shàng de měi yí gè jīnsè dàzì, dōu shì Zhōnghuá érnǚ duì shēnghuó zuì shēnqíng de biǎodá. Nà yí fùfù hóngzhǐ hēizì de yínglián, xiěmǎn le duì suìxù gèngdié de yóuzhōng zànměi yǔ duì jiātíng ānkāng de yīnqiè qīpàn. Qiānbǎi nián lái, rénmen zhèng shì tōngguò zhèxiē gǔlǎo xíngshì, jiāng xuèmài xiānglián de wēnqíng dàidài chuándì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Every golden character on couplets is a heartfelt expression of affection for life. Black ink on red paper overflows with praise for season shifts and hopes for family welfare, transmitting ancestral warmth across generations.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cada trazo dorado en las coplas es una expresión entrañable de amor por la vida. La tinta sobre papel rojo celebra el fluir del tiempo y anhela la paz del hogar, transmitiendo el cariño familiar a través de las generaciones.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人机交互与情感计算领域，精准识别与数字化表达人类复杂微表情是核心攻关难点。研究团队融合多模态传感器数据与深度神经网络算法，使拟真虚拟数字人能够根据语境自然表达细微情感，显著提升了交互真实感。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài rénjī jiāohù yǔ qínggǎn jìsuàn lǐngyù, jīngzhǔn shíbié yǔ shùzìhuà biǎodá rénlèi fùzá wēibiǎoqíng shì héxīn gōngguān nándiǎn. Yánjiū tuánduì rónghé duōmótài chuángǎnqì shùjù yǔ shēndù shénjīng wǎngluò suànfǎ, shǐ nǐzhēn xūnǐ shùzìrén nénggòu gēnjù yǔjìng zìrán biǎodá xìwēi qínggǎn, xiǎnzhù tíshēng le jiāohù zhēnshígǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In human-computer interaction and affective computing, identifying and digitally expressing subtle micro-expressions is vital. Teams combine multimodal sensors with neural networks, enabling virtual avatars to convey nuanced emotions naturally.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la computación afectiva, descifrar y expresar digitalmente las microexpresiones humanas es un hito de I+D. Los científicos fusionan sensores y redes neuronales para que avatares virtuales manifiesten emociones sutiles con realismo.

meanings_summary.en: meaning; sense; significance; value; importance
meanings_summary.es: significado; sentido; significación; valor; importancia

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The resonant sound of your heart (意) aligned with moral justice (义) defines the true meaning and significance of life.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La voz del corazón (意) unida a la noble rectitud (义) define el sentido y significado profundo de la vida.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian hermeneutics, 'yì' (inner mental intention) and 'yì' (normative moral justice) unite into the highest ontological standard of significance.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual 4th tones: 'yì yì' (51-51). Both syllables descend sharply with crisp, authoritative articulation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 意义 encompasses both linguistic/symbolic semantics (what words mean) and axiological/existential value (worth, importance).

contrasts.analysis: 意义 is formal and refers to profound significance, semantic value, or philosophical purpose, whereas 意思 is colloquial and can mean casual meaning, interest, fun, or a token gift.
意义 emphasizes moral, historical, or intellectual significance, while 价值 denotes measurable economic worth, utility, or exchange price.
意义 evaluates ideological or historical importance, while 作用 describes concrete functional mechanics, efficacy, or impact in practice.

Has 丷 over 口 and 心 instead of 音

Has a horizontal cross-stroke instead of angled slash in 义

senses.definition_en: the semantic import or message conveyed by words, actions, or symbols; meaning
senses.definition_es: significado semántico o mensaje que transmiten palabras o ritos
senses.example_phrase: 词语的真正意义 (the true meaning of the term)

senses.definition_en: value, worth, or monumental historical/social significance
senses.definition_es: valor; trascendencia o importancia histórica o social
senses.example_phrase: 具有深远的现实意义 (possess far-reaching practical significance)

example_sentences.hanzi: 除夕守岁不仅是一项充满温情的传统习俗，更具有祈求全家平安、尊老敬贤的深刻文化意义。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chúxī shǒusuì bùjǐn shì yí xiàng chōngmǎn wēnqíng de chuántǒng xísú, gèng jùyǒu qíqiú quánjiā píng'ān, zūnlǎojìngxián de shēnkè wénhuà yìyì.
example_sentences.en: New Year's Eve vigil is not only a warm folk tradition, but carries profound cultural meaning in praying for family safety and honoring elders.
example_sentences.es: Trasnochar en Nochevieja es una entrañable costumbre tradicional cargada de hondo sentido cultural: orar por la paz del hogar y honrar a los mayores.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该项清洁能源重大技术突破的成功应用，对于推动国家能源安全战略转型具有里程碑意义。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi xiàng qīngjié néngyuán zhòngdà jìshù tūpò de chénggōng yìngyòng, duìyú tuīdòng guójiā néngyuán ānquán zhànlüè zhuǎnxíng jùyǒu lǐchéngbēi yìyì.
example_sentences.en: The successful application of this clean energy breakthrough bears milestone significance for the transition of national energy security.
example_sentences.es: La aplicación de este hito técnico en energías limpias reviste un valor histórico trascendental para la seguridad energética nacional.

concise words with profound meaning; pithy and comprehensive
inspiring awe with upholding justice and righteousness

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining voice/sound 音 resonating from deep inside the heart 心, signifying genuine inner intention and meaning.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The inner voice and sound (音) stirring within your sincere heart (心) forms your true intent and meaning (意).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La voz y el son (音) que brotan de lo hondo del corazón (心) expresan la verdadera intención y sentido (意).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram depicting offering a sacrificial lamb (羊) with dignity (我), signifying moral rectitude and solemn purpose.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A single resolute stroke of moral integrity upholds truth, embodying justice and noble meaning (义).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un trazo resuelto de integridad moral sostiene la verdad, encarnando la justicia y el hondo significado (义).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 传统节日的真正意义，从来不仅在于丰盛的酒席与华丽的礼节，更在于唤醒人们对岁月流转的敬畏与对家庭亲情的眷恋。除夕夜那盏长明的红灯笼，照亮了游子归家的路途，也守护着一个民族生生不息的精神家园。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuántǒng jiérì de zhēnzhèng yìyì, cónglái bùjǐn zài yú fēngshèng de jiǔxí yǔ huálì de lǐjié, gèng zài yú huànxǐng rénmen duì suìyuè liúzhuǎn de jìngwèi yǔ duì jiātíng qīnqíng de juànliàn. Chúxī yè nà zhǎn chángmíng de hóng dēnglong, zhàoliàng le yóuzǐ guījiā de lùtú, yě shǒuhù zhe yí gè mínzú shēngshēngbùxī de jīngshén jiāyuán.
extended_reading_passages.en: The true meaning of holidays lies not in lavish feasts, but in reverence for time and family warmth. The red lantern of New Year's Eve lights travelers' journeys home and guards an enduring spiritual homeland.
extended_reading_passages.es: El verdadero sentido de las fiestas ancestrales trasciende el banquete; despierta veneración por el tiempo y apego al hogar. El farolillo bermejo ilumina el regreso de los ausentes, custodiando el alma imperecedera de un pueblo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在构建人类命运共同体的宏大框架下，加强跨文明对话与文明互鉴具有不可估量的时代意义。不同文明在平等包容中深化相互理解、消除隔阂偏见，将为破解全球和平赤字与实现全人类可持续繁荣提供深层智慧启示。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gòujiàn rénlèi mìngyùn gòngtóngtǐ de hóngdà kuàngjià xià, jiāqiáng kuà wénmíng duìhuà yǔ wénmíng hùjiàn jùyǒu bùkě gūliàng de shídài yìyì. Bùtóng wénmíng zài píngděng bāoróng zhōng shēnhuà xiānghù lǐjiě, xiāochú géhé piānjiàn, jiāng wèi pòjiě quánqiú hépíng chìzì yǔ shíxiàn quán rénlèi kěchíxù fánróng tígōng shēncéng zhìhuì qǐshì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In building a human community with a shared future, cross-civilizational dialogue holds immeasurable significance. Deepening mutual understanding dissolves prejudices, inspiring wisdom to resolve peace deficits and foster global prosperity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Fomentar el diálogo intercultural encierra un significado histórico de trascendencia incalculable. El entendimiento entre civilizaciones disuelve recelos, inspirando sabiduría para superar brechas y afianzar la concordia mundial.

meanings_summary.en: firecrackers; strings of small explosive bangers
meanings_summary.es: petardos; traca; fuegos artificiales sonoros

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A long leather cord (鞭) strung with gunpowder packages that explode in fire (炮) creates festive crackling firecrackers.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una tira flexible (鞭) cuajada de envoltorios de pólvora que estallan al fuego (炮) conforma la alegre traca de petardos.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originally heated green bamboo cylinders that popped loudly in fire (爆竹), 'biānpào' evolved into rolled paper strings of black powder, central to warding off pestilence (辟邪) and greeting the dawn of a fresh year.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'biān' (55) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'pào' (51). Clean descent from 55 to 51.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 鞭炮 specifically designates paper-wrapped strings of small acoustic-burst explosives that pop in rapid auditory succession.

contrasts.analysis: 鞭炮 emphasizes loud crackling acoustic noise designed to ward off misfortune, whereas 烟花 focuses on elevated visual fireworks displaying luminous colors in the sky.
爆竹 is the classical, literary term originating from popping bamboo joints, whereas 鞭炮 is the modern, colloquial noun for woven strings of firecrackers.
鞭炮 refers to harmless festive paper firecrackers, whereas 大炮 denotes heavy military artillery cannons.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 圭 on the right of 革 instead of 便 in 鞭
Has 巴 on the right of 革 instead of 便
Has foot radical 足 on left instead of fire 火 in 炮
Has food radical 饣 on left instead of 火

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: bamboo; root of ancient 爆竹

senses.definition_en: strings of small explosive cylinders rolled in paper and ignited to create loud popping sounds during festive celebrations; firecrackers
senses.definition_es: tiras o sartas de pequeños cilindros explosivos de papel que estallan festivamente; petardos; tracas
senses.example_phrase: 放鞭炮庆贺新年 (set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year)

example_sentences.hanzi: 新年零点钟声敲响时，街头巷尾响起了震耳欲聋的鞭炮声，绚烂的火花把夜空装点得分外喜庆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xīnnián língdiǎn zhōngshēng qiāoxiǎng shí, jiētóuxiàngwěi xiǎngqǐ le zhèn'ěryùlóng de biānpào shēng, xuànlàn de huǒhuā bǎ yèkōng zhuāngdiǎn de fènwài xǐqìng.
example_sentences.en: When the midnight bell struck, deafening firecrackers crackled through alleys, and splendid sparks adorned the festive night sky.
example_sentences.es: Al dar la medianoche, las calles estallaron en un fragor ensordecedor de petardos; las chispas vistieron la noche con un fulgor festivo deslumbrante.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为改善城市空气质量并预防火灾隐患，许多特大城市对主城区燃放烟花鞭炮实行了严格的禁放与限放规定。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèi gǎishàn chéngshì kōngqì zhìliàng bìng yùfáng huǒzāi yǐnhuàn, xǔduō tèdà chéngshì duì zhǔchéngqū ránfàng yānhuā biānpào shíxíng le yángé de jìnfàng yǔ xiànfàng guīdìng.
example_sentences.en: To improve urban air quality and prevent fire hazards, megacities enacted strict bans and restrictions on setting off firecrackers in urban centers.
example_sentences.es: Para purificar el aire urbano y evitar incendios, muchas metrópolis decretaron la prohibición estricta o restricción del uso de petardos en el casco urbano.

fire trees and silver flowers; dazzling display of lanterns and fireworks
jubilant and exultant; inspired with boundless enthusiasm
flourishing and prosperous; thriving with vital energy

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where leather radical 革 indicates a braided leather lash, extending to long strings of linked explosives.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A flexible braided leather cord (革) hanging convenient to hand (便) whips the air with sharp cracks (鞭).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una correa de cuero trenzado (革) manejada con agilidad (便) restalla en el aire con un chasquido agudo (鞭).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where fire radical 火 indicates pyrotechnic combustion, and 包 denotes gunpowder wrapped tightly in paper.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Gunpowder wrapped snugly in paper (包) ignited by a flame (火) explodes in a festive bursting firecracker (炮).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pólvora envuelta en papel (包) que estalla al contacto con el fuego (火) produciendo un alegre petardo (炮).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 噼噼啪啪的鞭炮声是记忆中最深沉的年味。每当除夕午夜的钟声敲响，庭院内外便升腾起浓烈的硝烟与硫磺清香，满地落红如同铺开了一层厚实的红地毯。那震天的回响不仅驱走了传说的年兽，更迎来了崭新岁月的万象更新。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Pīpīpāpā de biānpào shēng shì jìyì zhōng zuì shēnchén de niánwèi. Měidāng Chúxī wǔyè de zhōngshēng qiāoxiǎng, tíngyuàn nèiwài biàn shēngténg qǐ nóngliè de xiāoyān yǔ liúhuáng qīngxiāng, mǎndì luòhóng rútóng pūkāi le yì céng hòushí de hóng dìtǎn. Nà zhèntiān de huíxiǎng bùjǐn qūzǒu le chuánshuō de Nián shòu, gèng yínglái le zhǎnxīn suìyuè de wànxiàng gēngxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Crackling firecrackers are the deepest memory of festive cheer. At midnight, fragrant sulfur smoke rises as scarlet paper carpets the ground. The reverberations not only drove off Nian, but ushered in nature's renewal.
extended_reading_passages.es: El chasquido de los petardos evoca el sabor más hondo del Año Nuevo. A medianoche, el humo aromático se eleva y los papeles rojos alfombran el suelo; su eco no solo ahuyentó a la fiera Nian, sino que saludó un porvenir venturoso.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着现代公众绿色生态意识的普及，电子模拟鞭炮与数字灯光秀正在成为传统节庆消费的新潮流。新型环保电子鞭炮采用声光电微控技术，完美重现爆竹炸响的欢腾气氛且无烟尘排放，兼顾了传统民俗传承与现代空气质量要求。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe xiàndài gōngzhòng lǜsè shēngtài yìshí de pǔjí, diànzǐ mónǐ biānpào yǔ shùzì dēngguāngxiù zhèngzài chéngwéi chuántǒng jiéqìng xiāofèi de xīn cháoliú. Xīnxíng huánbǎo diànzǐ biānpào cǎiyòng shēngguāngdiàn wēikòng jìshù, wánměi chóngxiàn bàozhú zhàxiǎng de huānténg qìfēn qiě wú yānchén páifàng, jiāngù le chuántǒng mínsú chuánchéng yǔ xiàndài kōngqì zhìliàng yāoqiú.
extended_reading_passages.en: As eco-consciousness spreads, electronic firecrackers and digital light shows lead holiday trends. Eco-friendly electronic crackers reproduce festive sounds without emissions, reconciling folk heritage with air quality standards.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con la conciencia ecológica, los petardos electrónicos y espectáculos de luces marcan tendencia festiva. Recrean con fidelidad el ambiente jovial sin emisiones de humo, aunando el folclore tradicional con la pureza del aire urbano.
